intro_en: Jia Jia in Friedenau serves home-style Chinese dishes, Northeastern-style barbecue and Sichuan-style hot dishes. The menu includes lamb and beef skewers, grilled lamb ribs, mala xiang guo, water-boiled beef, mao xue wang, guo bao rou, dumplings and chili-oil wontons, making it suitable for Chinese dinners and group meals.

intro_en: 7 Dumpling is a casual Chinese snack shop centered on dumplings, wontons, baozi, xiao long bao, siu mai and lao noodles. It suits quick meals built around handmade dumplings, wonton soup or simple noodle bowls.

intro_en: This Sichuan restaurant in Charlottenburg covers cold starters, dim sum, steamed dishes, boiled chili-oil dishes, dry-pot dishes, and classic stir-fries, making it well suited to group sharing.

intro_en: Spandau's large Chinese buffet restaurant focuses on lunch, evening, and weekend buffet dining, with menu-photo evidence for selected a-la-carte chicken, duck, pork, beef, fish, and prawn dishes. It is well suited to family meals and group dining.

intro_en: Apailon on Uhlandstraße serves Chinese noodle dishes such as braised beef noodle soup, scallion-oil noodles, zha jiang noodles, spicy shrimp noodle soup, crispy duck noodles, hot-and-sour minced-meat noodles and cold sesame-peanut noodles.

intro_en: Aroma is a long-established Cantonese restaurant on Kantstraße focused on dim sum, cheung fun, roast duck, char siu and crispy pork belly, with seafood, clay-pot dishes and classic Cantonese hot dishes as well. It suits dim sum, roast meats and late Cantonese meals.

intro_en: Aroma Friedrichshain focuses on Cantonese dim sum, cheung fun, roast duck, char siu and crispy pork belly, with seafood, clay-pot dishes and classic Cantonese hot dishes as well. It works for dim sum, roast meats and shared Cantonese meals.

intro_zh: 美食家 Asia Deli 位于 Wedding 的 Seestraße 附近，主打湘味家常菜和辣味热炒。菜单里有毛氏红烧肉、鱼香肉丝、辣子鸡、东安鸡、鱼香茄子、梅菜扣肉、锅包肉、水煮鱼、酸菜鱼、香辣蟹，以及茄子煲、海鲜豆腐煲等砂锅菜。适合想吃实惠中餐、重口味湘菜、鱼类菜和下饭热炒的客人。
intro_en: Asia Deli is a casual Chinese restaurant near Seestraße in Wedding, focused on Hunan-style home cooking and spicy wok dishes. The menu includes Mao-style braised pork, yu-xiang shredded pork, la zi ji, Dong-An chicken, yu-xiang eggplant, meicai kourou, guo bao rou, water-boiled fish, suan cai yu, spicy crab, and several clay-pot dishes. It is a good fit for diners looking for hearty, spicy Chinese food and everyday home-style dishes.

intro_zh: 农夫乐 Asia Farmhouse 位于 Neukölln 的 Pannierstraße，走中式融合小馆路线。菜单重点是自制点心、小笼包、虾饺、烧卖、锅贴、馄饨、北京鸭卷、手工面、海鲜面、热锅和适合分享的小盘菜。相比传统大菜馆，这里更适合想吃点心、小盘中餐、手工面和轻松聚餐的客人。
intro_en: Asia Farmhouse in Neukölln is a casual Chinese-Asian fusion restaurant built around homemade dim sum, small plates, handmade noodles and hot-pot dishes. The menu includes xiao long bao, har gow, siu mai, fried dumplings, wonton soup, Peking duck wraps, seafood noodles, noodle soup and shareable mains. It is best suited for diners looking for dim sum, handmade noodles and a relaxed small-plate meal.

intro_zh: Friedenau 的老牌中餐馆，菜单明显偏川味和家常重口，凉菜、烤鱼、水煮、干锅、辣子鸡和锅包肉这类菜占主轴。
intro_en: This long-running restaurant in Friedenau clearly leans toward bold Sichuan and home-style flavors. Cold starters, grilled fish, boiled chili-oil dishes, dry pot, laziji, and guobao pork make up the core of the menu.

intro_zh: Kantstraße 的面馆，菜单核心是四类面：刀削面、拌面、油泼面和炒面，另有几种水饺。适合按具体面型搜索和快速用餐。
intro_en: Ban Noodle on Kantstraße focuses on four noodle formats: dao xiao mian, dry mixed noodles, youpo noodles, and fried noodles, with several dumpling options alongside them.
cuisines_zh: ["拌面", "刀削面", "油泼面", "炒面", "饺子"]

intro_zh: Mitte 的 Bang Bang Noodles 主打手工宽面，核心菜品是 Bang Bang Beef、Tofu、Chili 以及牛肉末和素肉末宽面，配少量炸馄饨、鸡块和鸡肉包。
intro_en: Bang Bang Noodles Mitte focuses on hand-pulled wide noodles, especially Bang Bang Beef, Tofu, Chili, minced beef, and vegan minced noodles, with fried wontons, chicken bites, and a chicken bun as sides.
cuisines_zh: ["手工宽面", "拌面", "包类小食", "馄饨"]

intro_zh: Kreuzberg 的 Bang Bang Noodles 菜单与 Mitte 基本一致，主打 Bang Bang/Biang Biang 风格手工宽面，另有炸馄饨、鸡块和鸡肉包。
intro_en: Bang Bang Noodles Kreuzberg follows the same core menu as the Mitte branch: Bang Bang/Biang Biang-style hand-pulled wide noodles plus fried wontons, chicken bites, and a chicken bun.
cuisines_zh: ["手工宽面", "拌面", "包类小食", "馄饨"]

intro_zh: Kottbusser Damm 上的台湾风味小馆，主打手工牛肉汤面、猪肉水饺、煎饺和卤肉饭，也有台式鸡肉米粉、手工炒面、春卷和馄饨汤，适合想吃简单热食和面点的快速用餐。
intro_en: Beef House on Kottbusser Damm is a Taiwanese-style casual spot centered on handmade beef noodle soup, pork dumplings, pan-fried dumplings, and lu rou fan, with Formosa-style rice noodles, handmade fried noodles, spring rolls, and wonton soup as supporting dishes.

intro_zh: Friedrichshain 的本味主打北方风格面点和简餐，菜单核心是内蒙古羊肉烧麦、各类饺子和包子、牛肉水煎包、肉夹馍、羊肉串，以及鸡排拌面、红烧牛肉面和番茄牛肉面。
intro_en: Benwei Essence in Friedrichshain focuses on northern-style Chinese comfort food: Inner Mongolian lamb shaomai, dumplings, baozi, pan-fried beef buns, rou jia mo, lamb skewers, and a compact noodle menu led by chicken cutlet dry noodles and beef noodle soup.

intro_zh: Bikini Berlin 里的 Biang Biang Ming 主打 biang biang 风格宽面和油泼面，也有牛腩汤面、饺子、红油饺子、素包子和甜包；早餐时段还能吃到粥、烧卖、馄饨汤、荷叶糯米鸡等点心。
intro_en: Biang Biang Ming in Bikini Berlin is a casual branch built around biang-biang-style wide noodles and youpo noodles, with beef noodle soup, dumplings, chili-oil dumplings, vegetable bao, sweet bao, and a breakfast-hour selection of congee and dim sum.

intro_zh: Schloss-Straßen-Center 里的 Biang Biang Ming 主打 biang biang 风格宽面和油泼面，也有牛腩汤面、排骨拌面、牛肉拌面、饺子、红油饺子、素包子和甜包，适合商场里的快速面食用餐。
intro_en: Biang Biang Ming in Schloss-Straßen-Center focuses on biang-biang-style wide noodles and youpo noodles, with beef noodle soup, pork rib dry noodles, beef hand-pulled noodles, jiaozi, chili-oil jiaozi, vegetable bao, and sweet bao.

intro_en: Bingery in Schöneberg is a Chinese jianbing shop focused on freshly made Chinese crepe pockets, with sausage, chicken, braised beef, teriyaki tofu, and spicy noodle versions, plus soy milk, braised beef sides, and bing fen.

intro_en: Cha for Tee in Kreuzberg is a tea-and-dim-sum spot focused on Chinese dumplings and small bites, including vegan dumplings, vegan xiao long bao, baozi, sticky-rice siu mai, har gow, pork wontons in chili oil, nuo mi ci, and liu sha bao.

intro_zh: Chaomin 是 Prenzlauer Berg 一家以粥、西安小吃、川湘风味菜和点心为主的中餐厅。它不是专门火锅店，但有少见的彩米粥火锅：先点粥底锅，再配虾、鱿鱼、鱼、牛肉、鸡肉、蔬菜菌菇、豆腐和油条。
intro_en: Chaomin is a Prenzlauer Berg Chinese restaurant centered on congee, Xi'an street food, dim sum, and Sichuan-Hunan dishes. It is not a dedicated hotpot restaurant, but offers an unusual congee hotpot with prawns, squid, fish, beef, chicken, vegetables, mushrooms, tofu and fried dough sticks.

intro_en: Chen's Wok is a Chinese restaurant in Charlottenburg with a Sichuan-leaning menu that includes dim sum, roast duck, spicy fish dishes, Mao Xue Wang, Mao Cai, grilled fish and wok-style meat, seafood and vegetable plates.

intro_en: Chengdu Nudelhaus in Mitte serves Chongqing noodles, Yibin Ran Mian, Dan Dan noodles, sour-spicy sweet potato noodles and rice noodles, alongside handmade wontons, dumplings, xiaolongbao and Sichuan cold and steamed dishes.

intro_en: Chi Chi Kan is a Chinese restaurant in Schöneberg focused on housemade dim sum, Dan Dan noodles, beef noodle soup and Sichuan-style meat, seafood and tofu dishes such as spicy beef stew, Hui Guo pork, cumin lamb and Suan Cai Yu.

intro_en: China City on Leipziger Straße in Mitte serves a €70 Peking duck set for two, with each additional person €35. The set includes Wan-Tan soup, marinated tofu and sliced beef brawn, sliced duck with cucumber, green onion and 12 pancakes, and fried bananas with honey.

intro_en: China-Town is a neighborhood Chinese restaurant in Lichtenrade with a German-Chinese menu focused on sweet-and-sour pork, Sa-Cha beef, cashew chicken, sesame chicken, crispy duck, prawns and fish fillet dishes.

intro_en: China Town is a small Chinese bistro in Pankow with a compact German-Chinese menu centered on tofu with vegetables, crispy duck, sweet-and-sour chicken and Gong Bao chicken.

intro_en: Chuan Garden is a Sichuan restaurant on Torstraße with a focus on Zigong-style rabbit, fresh chili fish, Suan Cai Yu, La Zi Ji, boiled beef in chili broth, dim sum, Dan Dan noodles and Yibin Ran Mian.

intro_en: Chuan House is a Sichuan restaurant in Friedrichshain with dim sum, chili-oil wontons, Dan Dan Mian, La Zi Ji, water-boiled beef and fish, twice-cooked pork, Mapo tofu, prawns and vegetable dishes.

intro_en: CHUWOO is a Chinese snack and noodle spot in Mitte, centered on Shengzhou-style xiao long bao, gua bao, Dan Dan noodles, oil-splashed noodles, mapo tofu noodles, noodle soups, braised pork rice and pork trotter rice.

intro_en: Do De Li is a Chinese restaurant on Kantstraße focused on Yunnan-style crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, chili-oil wontons, Mapo tofu, garlic eggplant and a compact set of chicken, beef and pork dishes.

intro_zh: 东海楼位于 Prenzlauer Berg，主打整只北京烤鸭，也有虾饺、烧卖、小笼包、牛肉煎饺等点心，以及脆皮鸭、鱼香肉丝、四川牛肉、豉汁鱿鱼和三文鱼菜。
intro_en: Donghailou is a Chinese restaurant in Prenzlauer Berg centered on whole Peking duck, with dim sum, crispy duck specialties, Yu Xiang pork, Sichuan-style beef, squid with black beans and salmon dishes.

intro_zh: 一点茶寮是 Prenzlauer Berg 的中式茶吧小吃店，食物菜单突出茶香排骨、茶香双椒鸡、茶香饺子、重庆酸辣粉、酸汤米粉和凉点面，适合喝茶配小食或轻简餐。
intro_en: Dot Tea Bar is a Chinese tea bar in Prenzlauer Berg with tea-infused small plates, tea-aroma dumplings, Chongqing hot-and-sour noodles, sour soup rice noodles and cold noodles.
cuisines_zh: ["茶吧", "中式小吃", "酸辣粉", "茶香菜"]

intro_zh: 帆船酒楼位于 Schmargendorf，是一家老牌中餐馆，菜单以川菜热菜、点心、火锅和烤鸭类菜品为主，适合家庭聚餐、多人火锅或想吃传统中餐正餐的场景。
intro_en: Dschunke is a long-running Chinese restaurant in Schmargendorf, with a menu built around Sichuan mains, dim sum, hot pot and duck dishes including Peking duck. It works well for family meals, group dinners and classic Chinese dining.

intro_zh: 香味小站位于 Ostbahnhof 附近，菜单偏亚洲融合简餐，包含蜜汁鸡球、台式卤肉、中华风味炸鸭、蔬菜豆腐以及寿司盒等选择。
intro_en: Duftküche near Ostbahnhof is an Asian-fusion quick-meal spot with dishes such as honey chicken balls, Taiwanese braised pork belly, Chinese-style fried duck, tofu with vegetables and sushi boxes.

intro_zh: Dump Ling 是 Alte Schönhauser Straße 上的现代中式饺子面馆，菜单集中在小笼包、煎饺、水饺、馄饨、包子和重庆小面等小吃主食，适合快速午餐或轻松晚餐。
intro_en: Dump Ling is a modern Chinese dumpling and noodle spot on Alte Schönhauser Straße, centered on xiao long bao, pan-fried and boiled dumplings, wontons, baozi and Chongqing-style noodles.

intro_zh: Dumplings Nian 是 Kreuzberg 的中式饺子和包子小馆，菜单以水饺、煎饺、包子为核心，也提供锅包肉、红烧肉烧土豆、锅仔宫保鸡、麻婆豆腐等家常热菜。
intro_en: Dumplings Nian is a Kreuzberg Chinese dumpling spot centered on boiled dumplings, fried dumplings and baozi, with home-style mains such as guo bao rou, red-braised pork, Gong Bao chicken and mapo tofu.

intro_zh: En Lee Cai 是 Charlottenburg 一家偏外卖和简餐取向的中餐馆，菜单集中在脆皮鸭、甜酸炸鸡、牛肉西兰花、虾仁、麻婆豆腐和鱼香茄子等经典热菜。
intro_en: En Lee Cai is a compact Charlottenburg Chinese restaurant with familiar hot dishes such as crispy duck, sweet-and-sour chicken, beef with broccoli, prawns, mapo tofu and Yu Xiang eggplant.

intro_zh: Evergreen 是 Spandau 的传统中餐馆，菜单走经典德式中餐路线，重点是脆皮鸭、宫保鸡丁、咕咾肉、四川牛肉、宫保大虾、鱼柳和豆腐热菜，适合家庭聚餐和常规堂食。
intro_en: Evergreen is a classic Chinese restaurant in Spandau with a traditional German-Chinese menu built around crispy duck, Gong Bao chicken, sweet-and-sour pork, Sichuan beef, prawns, fish fillet and tofu dishes.

intro_zh: 福·山里小馆是 Charlottenburg Kantstraße 上的云贵川风味小馆，菜单包含毛辣果酸汤、铜锅油焖鸡、歌乐山辣子鸡、薄荷炸排骨、黔贵干煸牛脆脆和小锅米线，也有素菜、甜品和中式调酒。
intro_en: FúFú Bistro is a Southwestern Chinese bistro on Kantstraße in Charlottenburg, with Yunnan, Guizhou and Sichuan dishes such as sour soup, braised chicken, spicy chicken, mint pork ribs, crispy beef and rice noodles, plus vegetarian dishes, desserts and Chinese-style drinks.

intro_zh: 王家一号是一家带有温州青田背景的中餐馆，除了烤鸭卷、宫保鸡丁、水煮鱼、酸菜鱼、回锅肉等常见硬菜，也突出青田大饼、青田山粉饺和腊肉炒米粉这类浙南家乡小吃。
intro_en: Feast Fine East Cuisine combines Qingtian and Wenzhou-style snacks with a broad Chinese menu. Qingtian pancakes, Qingtian ravioli and fried rice noodles sit alongside roast duck rolls, Gong Bao chicken, Sichuan fish, pork belly and tofu dishes.
cuisines_zh: ["青田小吃", "浙南风味", "川菜", "点心"]

intro_zh: 丰源饭店是 Lankwitz 一家传统德式中餐馆，菜单以小笼包、虾饺、锅贴等点心，以及脆皮鸭、回锅肉、鱼香肉丝、宫保大虾、海鲜锅和豆腐菜为主，适合日常堂食和外卖。
intro_en: Feng Yuan is a classic Chinese restaurant in Lankwitz with dim sum, crispy duck, twice-cooked pork, Yu Xiang pork, Gong Bao prawns, seafood pot, fish and tofu dishes for everyday dine-in or delivery.

intro_zh: 福多酒家位于 Pankow 北侧，整体更像社区型中餐自助和家庭聚餐餐厅；菜单主要覆盖鸡肉、猪肉、牛肉主菜，包括甜酸炸鸡、回锅肉、咕老肉、豆豉牛肉和多种蔬菜炒肉。
intro_en: Fu Duo is a neighborhood Chinese restaurant on the northern side of Pankow with a buffet and family-dining profile. The menu mainly covers chicken, pork and beef mains such as sweet-and-sour crispy chicken, hui guo rou, gu lao rou and black-bean beef.

intro_zh: 福利来不是单纯德式中餐馆，菜单里同时有肉夹馍、西安羊肉泡馍、陕西凉皮、油泼面、饺子等西北小吃，也有水煮牛肉、水煮鱼、辣子鸡、毛血旺、锅包肉、地三鲜和麻婆豆腐等川味与东北菜，适合想吃地域感更强的中餐。
intro_en: Fu Li Lai in Steglitz combines regional Chinese dishes rather than only German-style Chinese food. The menu includes rou jia mo, Xi’an lamb paomo, Shaanxi liangpi, youpo noodles and dumplings alongside Sichuan and Dongbei dishes such as water-boiled beef, water-boiled fish, la zi ji, mao xue wang, guo bao rou, di san xian and mapo tofu.

intro_zh: 南吉 / Südpol 位于 Neukölln 的 Kolonie Südpol，地图目前显示为暂停营业。历史菜单更像亚洲餐吧和花园聚会餐厅，重点包括蒸饺、煎饺、烧卖、炸馄饨、脆皮鸭、羊肉抓饭、豆豉五花肉和芝麻球。
intro_en: Gaststätte Food Bar Südpol is currently shown as temporarily closed. Its historical menu points to a garden-style Asian food bar with dumplings, siu mai, fried wontons, crispy duck, lamb pilaf, pork belly in bean sauce and sesame balls.

intro_zh: 永记是 Schöneberg 一家结构清晰的粤式点心馆，核心菜包括虾饺、烧卖、小笼包、叉烧包、流沙包、糯米鸡、豉汁凤爪、豉汁蒸排骨、牛肉肠粉、云吞汤面和干炒牛河，也有豆豉虾、麻婆豆腐和宫保类主菜。
intro_en: Goji is a Cantonese dim sum restaurant in Schöneberg with a focused menu of har gow, siu mai, xiao long bao, char siu bao, custard buns, lo mai gai, chicken feet, steamed pork ribs, beef cheung fun, wonton noodles and beef chow fun, plus a few main dishes such as black-bean prawns and mapo tofu.

intro_zh: Good Aroma 位于 Tempelhof，菜单更像轻量中式小吃和面饭小馆：红油抄手、蒸饺、小笼包、叉烧包、鲜虾饺、刈包、汤面、拌面和盖饭是主要内容。店名与 Happy Panda Tempelhof 存在重叠，适合想吃简单面点、包类和快捷主食的日常场景。
intro_en: Good Aroma in Tempelhof is a compact Chinese snack spot with wontons in chili oil, steamed dumplings, xiao long bao, char siu bao, har gow, gua bao, noodle soups, dry noodles, and rice bowls. The restaurant also appears under the Happy Panda Tempelhof name, making it a casual option for quick dumpling, bao, and noodle meals.

intro_zh: Good Friends 是 Kantstraße 上的老牌粤菜馆，菜单覆盖饮茶点心、烧鸭、叉烧、烧肉、云吞面、干炒牛河、煲仔类、海鲜和传统粤式主菜。适合想在柏林西区吃较完整粤菜、烧味和点心的聚餐场景。
intro_en: Good Friends on Kantstraße is a long-running Cantonese restaurant with dim sum, roast duck, char siu, crispy pork belly, wonton noodles, beef chow fun, clay-pot dishes, seafood, and classic Cantonese mains. It works well for group meals when the goal is a broad Hong Kong-style Chinese menu.

intro_zh: Green Flavor 位于 Kantstraße，菜单重点是自制点心和彩色蒸饺，也有红油馄饨、小笼包、烧卖、虾饺、牛肉炒河粉、地三鲜、干锅鸡和酸菜鱼。整体更像小而集中的现代中餐馆，适合想吃点心、饺子和几道川味主菜的日常聚餐。
intro_en: Green Flavor on Kantstraße focuses on house-made dim sum and colorful steamed jiaozi, alongside chili-oil wontons, xiao long bao, siu mai, har gow, beef rice noodles, di san xian, dry-pot chicken, and suan cai yu. It is a compact modern Chinese option for dumplings and a few Sichuan-leaning mains.

intro_zh: Han Bites 位于 Kantstraße，把中式烧烤、简餐和 KTV 包厢结合在一起。菜单重点是羊肉串、牛肉串、鸡翅、烤鱿鱼、蒜蓉粉丝扇贝、牛肉面、南昌炒粉、大盘鸡、孜然羊肉和麻婆豆腐，更适合朋友聚会、夜间小吃和边吃边唱的场景。
intro_en: Han Bites on Kantstraße combines Chinese skewers, casual plates, and private KTV rooms. The menu centers on lamb skewers, beef skewers, chicken wings, grilled squid, garlic scallops with glass noodles, beef noodle soup, Nanchang fried rice noodles, Xinjiang-style chicken, cumin lamb, and mapo tofu, making it a good fit for group nights out and late casual meals.

intro_zh: Happy Buddha 是 Marienfelde 的老牌社区中餐馆，菜单以北京烤鸭、香酥鸭、宫保类、黑豆豉类、咖喱和热炒主菜为主，也有素菜和豆腐选择。整体更适合家庭聚餐、多人分享和熟客型堂食。
intro_en: Happy Buddha is a long-running neighborhood Chinese restaurant in Marienfelde, with a broad menu built around Peking duck, crispy duck, Gon Bao dishes, black-bean-sauce plates, curries, and wok-style mains. It suits family meals, group dinners, and regular local dining.

intro_zh: Happy Panda 是 Gropiusstadt 的社区型中餐馆，菜单以脆皮鸭、鸡肉、牛肉、虾类热菜和铁板类主菜为主，也能找到水煮牛肉、麻辣鸡等偏辣选择。整体适合附近居民日常外卖、家庭晚餐和多人点菜分享。
intro_en: Happy Panda is a neighborhood Chinese restaurant in Gropiusstadt, with a broad menu focused on crispy duck, chicken, beef, prawns, teppan-style dishes, and spicy options such as Sichuan boiled beef and mala chicken. It works well for delivery, family meals, and shared dinners.

intro_en: Happy Panda Tempelhof is a Chinese restaurant centered on hand-pulled wide noodles, dumplings, xiao long bao, wontons, gua bao and rice bowls, with meat, tofu and vegetable options.

intro_zh: 喜临门是 Steglitz 的老牌中餐馆，菜单偏传统宴席风格，主线包括鸭类、牛肉、鸡肉、虾和鱼柳等热菜，也有麻婆豆腐、四川风味菜和三鲜类招牌菜。整体适合家庭聚餐、多人堂食和想吃经典老派中餐的场景。
intro_en: Hee Lam Mun is a long-running Chinese restaurant in Steglitz with a broad, old-school banquet-style menu. The core dishes include duck, beef, chicken, prawns, fish filet, mapo tofu, Sichuan-style plates, and mixed house specialties, making it suitable for family meals and group dinners.

intro_zh: 喜鹊楼位于 Pankow 的 Breite Str. 4A，菜单包含海鲜砂锅、酸辣鸭汤、蒜辣黄瓜和花椒豆腐等中式菜品。
intro_en: Hey Cheuk Lau on Breite Str. in Pankow serves Chinese dishes such as seafood clay pot, sour-spicy duck soup, chili-garlic cucumber salad and tofu with Sichuan pepper.

intro_zh: 海椒是 Mitte 的四川小吃和面食小馆，菜单集中在甜水面、豌杂面、泡椒牛肉面、抄手、钟水饺、现炸酥肉和粉蒸牛肉。整体适合想吃轻量但口味直接的川味主食、小吃和快餐式堂食。
intro_en: Hi! Chili is a compact Sichuan snack and noodle bistro in Mitte, built around fresh wheat noodles, chaoshou, Zhong dumplings, crispy pork bites, steamed beef with rice flour, and spicy small plates. It suits quick lunches, casual dinners, and focused Sichuan comfort food.

intro_zh: 好利私房菜是 Charlottenburg 的川湘家常菜馆，菜单里有口水鸡、凉粉、夫妻肺片、回锅肉、水煮牛肉、酸菜鱼、鱼香茄子和肉夹馍等。整体适合想吃重口味下饭菜、凉菜和手工面点的堂食或外带。
intro_en: China Restaurant Holly in Charlottenburg focuses on Sichuan and Hunan-style home cooking, with cold spicy starters, hui guo rou, Sichuan boiled beef, suan cai yu, yu xiang eggplant, roujiamo, and pan-fried jiaozi. It suits casual meals built around bold, rice-friendly dishes.

intro_zh: 聚友阁 Hot Spot 是 Wilmersdorf 的老牌中餐馆，菜单以川味热菜为主，也有江浙沪风味、北京鸭和预订类大菜。红油抄手、麻婆豆腐、水煮牛肉、香酥鸭、担担面和宫保类菜品适合多人分享，也适合想把中餐和葡萄酒搭配起来的晚餐。
intro_en: Restaurant Hot Spot in Wilmersdorf is a long-running Chinese restaurant with a Sichuan-leaning menu, Jiangsu-Shanghai influences, Peking duck, and preorder banquet dishes. Wontons in chili oil, mapo tofu, Sichuan boiled beef, crispy duck, dan dan noodles, and Gongbao dishes make it a strong option for shared dinners.

intro_zh: 大清面馆 Hotpot & Nudeln 是 Friedrichshain 的中式面馆和麻辣烫小店，核心是自选热锅面、牛肉面、重庆小面、担担面、炸酱面、点心和饺子。菜单围绕汤底、面食和小点展开，适合一个人快速吃一碗，也适合按口味自由搭配。
intro_en: Hotpot & Nudeln is a Chinese noodle-house and malatang spot in Friedrichshain, centered on customizable hot pot noodle soup, beef noodle soup, Chongqing-style noodles, dan dan noodles, zha jiang mian, dim sum, and dumplings. It works well for quick solo meals and casual customizable bowls.

intro_zh: 吼堂火锅柏林店位于 Kurfürstendamm，定位是正餐型川味火锅。菜单重点是锅型、酸菜豆花锅底、番茄锅底、骨汤锅底，以及现切牛肉、毛肚黄喉鹅肠拼盘、18秒嫩牛肉、香菜牛肉丝等火锅涮菜，适合多人聚餐。
intro_en: Hou Tang Hotpot is a Sichuan hotpot restaurant on Kurfürstendamm, centered on split-pot formats, sauerkraut tofu pudding broth, tomato broth, pork bone broth, fresh beef platters, offal platters, 18-second tender beef, and shared group dining.

intro_zh: 好好酒楼 How How 是 Wittenau 的老牌社区中餐馆，菜单偏粤式和德式中餐结合，有点心、小笼包、烧肉、脆皮鸭、海鲜、牛肉和鸡肉主菜，也提供预订北京鸭。整体适合家庭聚餐和传统堂食。
intro_en: How How is a long-running neighborhood Chinese restaurant in Wittenau, combining dim sum, Cantonese-style roast meats, crispy duck dishes, seafood, beef and chicken mains, and preorder Peking duck. It is best suited to family dinners and classic sit-down Chinese meals.

intro_zh: 华丽都位于 Pankow，菜单覆盖虾饺、烧卖、小笼包等点心，也有宫保鸡丁、麻婆豆腐、四川牛肉、脆皮鸭和需提前预订的北京烤鸭。它更适合家庭聚餐、多人点菜和想吃经典德式中餐结合点心选择的客人。
intro_en: Hua Li Du in Pankow offers a broad Chinese menu with har gow, siu mai, xiao long bao, kung pao chicken, mapo tofu, Sichuan-style beef, crispy duck and preorder Peking duck. It fits family meals, group dinners and diners looking for classic German-Chinese dishes with some dim sum options.
cuisines_zh: ["点心", "粤式烧味", "川味菜", "德式中餐"]

intro_zh: 华亭酒家位于 Strausberger Platz 附近，菜单是典型的老牌德式中餐结构，主打脆皮鸭、宫保类、铁板菜、鱼虾肉类主菜和双人拼盘。它适合家庭聚餐、多人点菜，以及想找经典中餐馆氛围和稳定大菜单的客人。
intro_en: HuaTing near Strausberger Platz is a classic Chinese restaurant with a broad German-Chinese menu. The strongest options are crispy duck, kung pao dishes, hot plates, fish and prawn mains, meat dishes and platters for two, making it suitable for family meals and group dinners.

intro_zh: 汇丰酒家位于 Hellersdorf，菜单覆盖小笼包、锅贴、虾饺、生煎包和饺子，也有回锅肉、咕咾肉、四川牛肉、招牌脆皮鸭、铁板鸭和需提前预订的北京烤鸭。它适合家庭聚餐、多人点菜和想在社区型中餐馆吃到点心加经典主菜的客人。
intro_en: Hui Feng in Hellersdorf combines a broad German-Chinese menu with dumplings and dim sum such as xiao long bao, guo tie, har gow, sheng jian bao and jiaozi. Main dishes include twice-cooked pork, sweet and sour pork, Sichuan beef, house-style crispy duck, hot-plate duck and preorder Peking duck.

intro_zh: 玉面阁 Charlottenburg 店位于 Kantstraße，菜单集中在手工面：油泼面、担担面、红烧牛肉面、豆腐面和番茄鸡蛋面是核心选择，另有口水鸡、醉鸡、卤牛肉和煎饺。它更适合专门来吃一碗面或简单点几份小食。
intro_en: Jade Palast Charlottenburg on Kantstrasse is built around hand-pulled noodles, especially youpo mian, dan dan noodles, braised beef noodle soup, tofu noodles and tomato egg noodles. The short side menu adds kou shui ji, drunken chicken, seasoned beef shank and pan-fried dumplings.

intro_zh: 玉面阁 2 位于 Friedrichshain / Boxi，相比 Kantstraße 分店更像完整小餐馆：既有油泼面、担担面、牛腩面和豆腐面，也有虾饺、小笼包、烧卖、北京鸭卷、麻婆豆腐、宫保鸡丁和脆皮鸭。适合想吃手工面，也适合多人一起加点点心和主菜。
intro_en: Jade Palast 2 in Friedrichshain / Boxi is broader than the Kantstrasse branch. It serves hand-pulled noodles such as youpo mian, dan dan noodles, beef noodle soup and tofu noodles, alongside har gow, xiao long bao, siu mai, Peking duck rolls, mapo tofu, kung pao chicken and crispy duck.
cuisines_zh: ["点心", "手工面", "脆皮鸭", "小馆简餐"]

intro_zh: 煎饼堂 Kerb Berlin 店是美食广场里的中国街头小吃摊，核心是现做天津绿豆煎饼，口味从传统款到纯素、香辣蘑菇素肉和鸡肉豪华款都有；另有两款麻酱饸饹面，适合快吃、带走和午餐场景。
intro_en: Jian Bing Town at Kerb Berlin is a focused Chinese street-food stall built around freshly made Tianjin-style mung bean jian bing. The menu ranges from a classic version to vegan, spicy mushroom soy-meat and pulled-chicken versions, plus two sesame-sauce hammered noodle bowls.

intro_zh: 新景阳位于 Steglitz，菜单重点是自制面食、饺子点心和盖饭。可选小笼包、锅贴、水煎包、红油抄手、葱油拌面、酸辣粉、牛肉面、油泼面、卤肉饭和鱼香肉丝盖饭，也有夫妻肺片、口水鸡等川味凉菜。
intro_en: Jing Yang in Steglitz is strongest for homemade noodles, dumplings, dim sum and rice bowls. The menu includes xiao long bao, guo tie, sheng jian bao, chili-oil wontons, scallion-oil dry noodles, suan la fen, beef noodle soup, youpo mian, lu rou fan and Sichuan-style cold dishes such as fuqi feipian and kou shui ji.

intro_zh: 嘉乐位于博物馆岛附近，核心卖点是北京鸭和点心，也有小笼包、虾饺、烧卖、锅贴、叉烧包、香酥鸭、黑椒牛肉、水煮牛肉、葱爆羊肉和孜然羊肉。它适合景点周边的正餐、多人聚餐和想点一桌北京鸭加点心的场景。
intro_en: Jolly near Museum Island is best known for Peking duck and dim sum, with xiao long bao, har gow, siu mai, guo tie, char siu bao, crispy duck, black pepper beef, shui zhu beef, scallion lamb and cumin lamb also on the menu. It suits group dinners and a fuller Chinese meal around Museum Island.

intro_zh: JuJu's Dumplings 是 Arminiusmarkthalle 里的现代饺子档口，菜单集中在煎饺/饺子和红油馄饨，口味包括四川辣牛肉、素肉花生酱、猪肉白菜、大虾莎莎、蘑菇松露和猪肉松露。它适合市场里快速吃一份小吃或几个人分享不同口味。
intro_en: JuJu's Dumplings in Arminiusmarkthalle focuses on modern loaded dumplings and chili-oil wontons. Fillings and toppings include Sichuan spicy beef, seitan with peanut sauce, pork and cabbage, king prawn with salsa, mushroom truffle, pork truffle and prawn wontons in dry tom yum.

intro_zh: Kaiser Drachen 位于 Johannisthal，属于社区型德式中餐馆。菜单照片中能看到回锅肉、上海鸭、冬菇竹笋脆皮鸭、四川牛肉、四川鸡片、炸大虾和咖喱鱼柳等熟悉主菜，适合附近居民日常堂食或外带。
intro_en: Kaiser Drachen in Johannisthal is a neighborhood-style Chinese restaurant with familiar German-Chinese mains. Representative dishes include twice-cooked pork, Shanghai crispy duck, crispy duck with bamboo and mushrooms, Sichuan beef, Sichuan chicken, battered prawns and curry fish fillet.
cuisines_en: ["German-style Chinese food", "home-style Chinese dishes", "neighborhood Chinese restaurant"]

intro_zh: Kamala Vegan 位于 Friedrichshain，是纯素中餐馆，菜单把麻婆豆腐、宫保鸡丁、回锅肉、鱼香茄子、地三鲜、干锅花菜、豆腐煲和黑椒素牛肉做成植物基版本，也有红油水饺、煎饺、糯米烧卖和包子。适合素食者、纯素聚餐和想吃川味素菜的客人。
intro_en: Kamala Vegan in Friedrichshain serves plant-based Chinese dishes, especially Sichuan-style vegan mains such as mapo tofu, gong bao vegan chicken, vegan hui guo rou, yu xiang eggplant, di san xian, dry-pot cauliflower, tofu stew and black pepper vegan beef, plus dumplings, siu mai and baozi.

intro_zh: 提供多种口味刨冰、抹茶饮品和紫菜包饭的咖啡馆。

intro_zh: King-Men 位于 Spandau，走老牌德式中餐路线。菜单重点包括脆皮鸭和鸡肉组合、蜜汁排骨、全家福火锅、铁板牛肉、三味牛肉、日式牛肉和素什锦等，适合本地家庭晚餐、多人点菜和日常外带。
intro_en: King-Men in Spandau is a neighborhood Chinese restaurant with a classic German-Chinese profile. Representative dishes include crispy duck and chicken combinations, honey ribs, happy-family hot pot, sizzling black pepper beef, spicy beef dishes, sukiyaki beef and vegetarian mixed vegetables.

intro_zh: KONG 位于 Prenzlauer Berg，是现代川味面馆，菜单集中在麻婆豆腐面、红烧牛肉面、辣椒牛肉面、青花椒米线、花生拌面、甜辣拌面和招牌酱面，也有钟水饺、麻辣饺子、清汤饺子、口水鸡和狼牙土豆。
intro_en: KONG in Prenzlauer Berg is a modern Sichuan-style noodle restaurant. The menu centers on mapo tofu noodles, braised beef noodle soup, chili beef noodles, green Sichuan pepper rice noodles, peanut dry noodles, sweet chili dry noodles and Kong special sauce noodles, plus dumplings and spicy starters.

intro_zh: 功夫辣椒位于 Prenzlauer Berg，核心是手工面和辣味面食，包括三合一、牛肉面、炸酱面、茄子面、花生拌面和二合一拌面，也有串串、麻辣土豆沙拉、功夫辣椒牛肉和柠檬虾等小吃。
intro_en: Kongfu Chili in Prenzlauer Berg is built around handmade noodles and spicy noodle dishes, including Three in One, beef noodles, zajiang noodles, eggplant noodles, peanut noodles and Two in One, with skewers, mala potato salad, Kongfuchili beef and lemon shrimp as snacks.
cuisines_zh: ["川味面食", "牛肉面", "手工面", "串串"]

intro_zh: 一面之缘位于 Lichterfelde / Botanischer Garten 一带，重点是四川风味手工面和小份分享菜。菜单里有油泼面、五香豆腐面、担担面、炸酱面、酸菜肉丝面、麻辣牛肉汤面、桂林米粉、广西老友粉，也有饺子、小笼包、排骨和月度甜点。
intro_en: LaLa Noodle of Sichuan in Lichterfelde focuses on handmade Sichuan-style noodles and small sharing dishes. The menu includes youpo mian, smoked tofu noodles, dan dan noodles, zhajiang noodles, pork and pickled vegetable noodles, Sichuan beef noodle soup, Guilin rice noodles, Old Friends rice noodles, dumplings and xiao long bao.

intro_zh: Kantstraße 这家兰州牛肉面店核心是手拉牛肉面，清汤、红烧、酸菜和牛仔骨等牛肉面都可归入兰州拉面体系；另外有新疆大盘鸡面、担担面、牛肉饺子、潼关肉夹馍、茶叶蛋、口水鸡和卤牛肉。适合专门来吃一碗热面或快速简餐。
intro_en: Lanzhou Beef Noodles in Charlottenburg is centered on Lanzhou-style hand-pulled beef noodles, including clear broth, hong shao, sour cabbage and braised beef-rib versions. The menu also includes Xinjiang big plate chicken noodles, dan dan noodles, beef dumplings, roujiamo, tea egg, kou shui ji and braised beef slices.
cuisines_zh: ["兰州拉面", "清真", "牛肉面", "手拉面"]

intro_zh: Lanzhou Beef Noodles 的 Friedrichshain 分店主打兰州风格手工牛肉面，也有红烧牛肉面、油泼面、担担面和新疆大盘鸡面。小食以牛肉饺子、潼关肉夹馍、卤牛肉和茶叶蛋为主，适合想吃一碗热汤面或简单配几样小吃的客人。
intro_en: The Friedrichshain branch of Lanzhou Beef Noodles focuses on Lanzhou-style hand-pulled beef noodles, with Hong Shao beef noodles, chili-oil noodles, dan dan noodles, and Xinjiang big plate chicken noodles alongside compact snacks such as beef dumplings, roujiamo, seasoned beef, and tea eggs.

intro_zh: 老乡位于 Prenzlauer Berg，菜单重点是粤式点心和粥品，也能点到红油抄手、肠粉、小笼包、叉烧包、糯米鸡、流沙包等饮茶类菜品。正餐部分有麻婆豆腐、酸菜鱼、孜然羊肉、脆皮烧肉和几道家常热炒，适合想吃点心，也适合多人点菜。
intro_en: Lao Xiang in Prenzlauer Berg is strongest for Cantonese-style dim sum and congee, including rice noodle rolls, xiaolongbao, char siu bao, sticky rice in lotus leaf, lava buns, and wontons in chili oil. The main menu also includes Mapo tofu, suan cai fish, cumin lamb, crispy pork belly, and several home-style Chinese dishes.

cuisines_en: ["Cantonese dim sum", "Cantonese cuisine", "Sichuan dishes", "home-style Chinese dishes"]

intro_zh: Lecker Song 位于 Prenzlauer Berg，主打各类中式饺子和点心。菜单里有素馅蒸饺、猪肉白菜饺、虾饺、烧卖、小笼包和多种煎饺，也能点到红油馄饨、北京炸酱面、豆沙包和糯米糍，适合想吃饺子或简单点心的一餐。
intro_en: Lecker Song in Prenzlauer Berg is built around Chinese dumplings and dim sum. The menu includes vegan steamed dumplings, pork-and-cabbage jiaozi, shrimp dumplings, shao mai, xiao long bao, several fried guo tie options, spicy wontons, Peking zhajiang noodles, red bean bao, and nuo mi ci.

intro_zh: 蕾小厨位于 Wedding，菜单以湘菜和川湘口味为主，能点到夫妻肺片、口水鸡、麻婆豆腐、地三鲜、辣椒炒肉、糖醋排骨、酸菜鱼、水煮鱼、香辣小龙虾和毛血旺。店里也有火锅自助和巫山烤鱼，适合想吃辣味热炒、鱼类或多人聚餐的客人。
intro_en: Lei's Küche in Wedding is a Hunan-style Chinese restaurant with a broad spicy menu. Key dishes include Fuqi Feipian, Koushui chicken, Mapo tofu, Di San Xian, Hunan chili pork, sweet-and-sour pork ribs, suan cai fish, Sichuan boiled fish, spicy crayfish, and Mao Xue Wang. The menu also includes hot pot buffet and Wushan-style grilled fish for group meals.

intro_zh: Little Little 位于 Charlottenburg，菜单集中在饺子、点心和面食。店里有小笼包、虾饺、素粉果、多种肉馅和素馅饺子，也有经典牛肉面、酸菜牛肉面、炸酱面、包子、红油馄饨和盐酥鸡，适合想吃简单面点或几样小吃分享的一餐。
intro_en: Little Little in Charlottenburg focuses on dumplings, dim sum, and noodles. The menu includes xiao long bao, shrimp dumplings, vegetable fen guo, several meat and vegan dumpling fillings, classic beef noodle soup, pickled-cabbage beef noodles, zhajiang noodles, baozi, wontons in chili oil, and Chinese popcorn chicken.

intro_zh: LIU 成都味道面馆位于 Stadtmitte 附近，菜单集中在成都风味面食和小吃。四川牛肉面、生椒牛肉面、四川杂酱面、酸辣粉、凉面、老麻抄手、酸辣抄手和钟水饺是核心菜品，整体味型偏麻辣，也有辣子鸡、麻辣藕片、铁板鱿鱼和麻辣鸡爪等小吃。
intro_en: LIU ChengduWeidao Nudelhaus near Stadtmitte focuses on Chengdu-style noodles and snacks. Core dishes include Sichuan beef noodles, shengjiao beef noodles, Sichuan zhajiang noodles, suan la fen, cold noodles, Laoma chaoshou, suan la chaoshou, and Zhong dumplings, with spicy snacks such as lazi chicken, lotus root, grilled squid, and chicken feet.

intro_zh: 龙门牛肉面大王位于 Kantstraße，是 Charlottenburg 很有辨识度的台湾面馆。菜单核心是牛肉面、馄饨面、红油馄饨、锅贴、水饺和小笼包，也有炸鸭面、炸排骨面、麻酱面、炒米粉、卤牛肉和台式割包，适合想吃台湾风味主食和小吃的一餐。
intro_en: Lon Men's Noodle House on Kantstraße is a Taiwanese noodle house centered on beef noodle soup, wonton noodles, wontons in chili oil, pan-fried dumplings, boiled dumplings, and xiaolongbao. The menu also includes crispy duck noodles, fried pork chop noodles, sesame peanut noodles, fried rice noodles, braised beef, and Taiwanese gua bao.

intro_zh: Lon-Min 位于 Schöneberg，更像传统社区型中餐馆，但菜单里保留了不少川菜和点心选择。可重点看宫保鸡丁、水煮鱼、水煮牛、麻婆豆腐、回锅肉、鱼香茄子、脆皮鸭、锅贴、虾饺和烧卖，也适合想点几道热菜或分享点心的用餐场景。
intro_en: Lon-Min in Schöneberg is a classic neighborhood Chinese restaurant with a useful mix of Sichuan dishes, dim sum, crispy duck, and house specialties. Notable dishes include Gongbao chicken, Sichuan boiled fish, Sichuan boiled beef, Mapo tofu, twice-cooked pork belly, yu xiang eggplant, crispy duck, guo tie, har gow, and siu mai.

intro_zh: Long Li House 位于 Reinickendorf，是典型社区型中餐馆和外卖店。菜单重点可以看脆皮鸭、川味牛肉/猪肉/鸡肉、回锅肉、炸鸡胸、豆腐、海鲜、鱼片、春卷、炸馄饨和芝麻球，整体更适合想要稳定、选择多的传统中式外卖或家庭聚餐。
intro_en: Long Li House in Reinickendorf is a classic neighborhood Chinese restaurant with a broad delivery-style menu. The most useful dishes to focus on are crispy duck, Szechuan-style beef, pork and chicken, twice-cooked pork, crispy chicken breast, tofu dishes, seafood, fish fillets, spring rolls, fried wontons, and sesame balls.

intro_zh: Long March Canteen 位于 Kreuzberg，风格是现代中式小盘和当代点心。菜单里有传统茄子、红油虾馄饨、蜜汁猪肋排、红烧五花肉、新加坡风味大虾、黑椒牛柳粒、北京鸭卷，以及鲜虾饺、牛肉饺、上海小笼包和烧卖等点心，适合多人分享和晚餐约会。
intro_en: Long March Canteen in Kreuzberg is a contemporary Chinese small-plates restaurant centered on modern dim sum and sharing dishes. The menu includes traditional aubergine, shrimp wontons in chili oil, soy-honey pork ribs, butter-soft pork belly, Singapore-style king prawns, black-pepper beef cubes, Peking-style duck pancakes, prawn dumplings, beef dumplings, Shanghai soup dumplings, and shou mai.

intro_zh: LU Kitchen 的 Bikini/Kantini 分店是商场里的中式快餐档口，菜单集中在刈包、盖饭和小吃。可以重点看刈包牛肉、刈包鸡肉、刈包豆腐、红油抄手、宫保豆腐饭、黑椒牛肉饭、蜜汁鸡腿饭，以及 Google 菜单照片中出现的牛肉馅饼和酱香饼。
intro_en: The Bikini/Kantini branch of LU Kitchen is a fast-casual Chinese stall focused on gua bao, rice bowls, and snacks. Useful dishes include beef, chicken, tofu, and tempura prawn gua bao, wontons in chili sauce, Gongbao tofu rice, black pepper beef rice, honey chicken rice, plus beef xian bing and jiang xiang bing from the photographed menu.
address: Kantini 1. OG, Bikini, Budapester Str. 38-50, 10787 Berlin, Germany

intro_zh: LU Kitchen Friedrichshain 比 Bikini 分店更像完整街区小店，菜单包含红烧牛肉面、北方炸酱面、麻酱拌面、桂花红烧肉饭、北京鸭饭、宫保豆腐饭、多款刈包和蒸饺。适合想快速吃一份饭面主食，或者点刈包和饺子当小吃的一餐。
intro_en: LU Kitchen Friedrichshain is a fast-casual Chinese spot with a broader menu than the Bikini branch. It serves braised beef noodle soup, northern zhajiang noodles, sesame sauce noodles, osmanthus braised pork belly rice, Peking duck rice, Gongbao tofu rice, several gua bao, and steamed dumplings.

intro_zh: 福仁 Lucky Chinese 位于 Alt-Tegel，是偏传统的德式中餐馆。菜单保留锅贴、烧卖、虾饺、炸馄饨，也有宫保鸡丁、上海鸭、炸鱼柳、炸大虾和麻婆豆腐，适合附近居民家庭聚餐或外带。
intro_en: Lucky Chinese in Alt-Tegel is a classic neighborhood Chinese restaurant with dim sum-style starters, German-style Chinese mains, crispy duck, fried fish fillet, king prawns and mapo tofu. It works best for casual family meals and takeaway in Tegel.

intro_zh: Lucky Star 全家福位于 Friedrichstraße，菜单以点心、川味热菜、脆皮鸭和水煮类菜品为主。适合想在 Mitte 吃虾饺、烧卖、锅贴、麻婆豆腐、酸菜鱼或水煮鱼的客人，也适合多人聚餐时选择火锅。
intro_en: Lucky Star in Friedrichstraße combines dim sum, Sichuan-style mains, crispy duck dishes and a locally noted hot-pot offer. It is a practical Mitte option for har gow, siu mai, potstickers, mapo tofu, suan cai fish and water-boiled fish, especially for casual group meals.

intro_zh: Lulu's 璐在 Charlottenburg 主打东北菜和川味热菜，菜单里有锅包肉、东北铁锅炖、红烧肉、水煮牛肉、水煮鱼、酸菜鱼和北京烤鸭，也提供自助火锅。适合想吃东北家常菜、辣味热菜或多人火锅聚餐的客人。
intro_en: Lulu's in Charlottenburg focuses on Dongbei dishes, Sichuan-style mains, Peking duck and an all-you-can-eat hotpot offer. The menu includes guo bao rou, Northeastern iron pot stew, braised pork belly, water-boiled beef, water-boiled fish and suan cai fish, making it useful for group meals and spicy Chinese dinners.

intro_zh: Lychee 位于 Wilmersdorf，菜单结合现代中餐、点心和川味热菜。适合搜索虾饺、烧卖、小笼包、叉烧包、北京烤鸭、清蒸鲈鱼、海鲜煲、宫保鸡丁、麻婆豆腐和地三鲜的客人，也适合想要更正式一点中餐环境的人。
intro_en: Lychee in Wilmersdorf combines modern Chinese dining with dim sum, Sichuan-style mains, seafood, Peking duck and vegetable/tofu dishes. It is a good match for searches around har gow, siu mai, xiao long bao, Peking duck, steamed sea bass, seafood pot, Gong Bao chicken, mapo tofu and di san xian.

intro_zh: Macao 是 Spandau 的老牌德式中餐馆，菜单以传统大盘热菜为主，包括四川牛肉、叉烧、腰果鸡、甜酸炸鸡、上海鸭、广式脆皮鸭和炸大虾。适合想吃熟悉型中餐、鸭类主菜或家庭聚餐的客人。
intro_en: China Restaurant Macao is a long-running Spandau Chinese restaurant with a classic German-style Chinese menu. The strongest search matches are Sichuan beef, char siu, chicken with cashews, sweet and sour chicken, Shanghai duck, Cantonese crispy duck and fried prawns.
cuisines_zh: ["德式中餐", "老牌中餐", "鸭肉主菜"]

intro_zh: Mala House 大碗麻辣烫位于 Charlottenburg，主打自选麻辣烫。菜单以牛肉、羊肉、鸡肉、海鲜和素食套餐为基础，客人可以选择辣度、汤底和面条类型，适合想快速吃一碗热辣麻辣烫的人。
intro_en: Mala House in Charlottenburg is focused on customizable malatang bowls. The menu is built around beef, lamb, chicken, seafood and vegan variants, with selectable spice level, soup base and noodle type, making it useful for quick solo meals or spicy takeout.

intro_zh: 万花酒楼 Man-Far 是 Spandau 的老牌德式中餐馆，菜单以传统大盘热菜为主。更有代表性的菜包括香酥鸭配大虾、上海鸭、四川牛肉、咕咾肉、腰果鸡丁、宫保大虾和炸鱼柳，适合家庭聚餐或熟悉型中餐需求。
intro_en: China-Restaurant Man-Far is a long-running Spandau Chinese restaurant with a classic German-style Chinese menu. Strong matches include crispy duck with king prawns, Shanghai duck, Sichuan beef, sweet and sour pork, chicken with cashews, Kung Pao prawns, and fried fish fillet.
cuisines_zh: ["德式中餐", "老牌中餐", "鸭肉主菜"]

intro_zh: 小桔碗 Mandarine Bowl 位于 Uhlandstraße，核心是小碗菜和盖浇饭模式：可以一人点卤肉饭、猪脚饭、宫保鸡丁盖饭或麻婆豆腐盖饭，也可以选水煮牛肉、辣子鸡、小炒黄牛肉、干锅虾、清蒸鲈鱼等大份热菜。菜单里也有盐水鸭和高汤干丝这类江苏/淮扬线索，适合快速午餐、一个人吃饭，也适合两三个人多点几道菜。
intro_en: Mandarine Bowl in Wilmersdorf is built around Chinese small-bowl sets, rice bowls and Sichuan-style hot dishes, with a smaller Jiangsu/Huaiyang thread through salted duck and tofu strips in superior broth. Useful matches include lu rou fan, braised pork trotter rice, Kung Pao chicken rice, mapo tofu rice, water-boiled beef, la zi ji, stir-fried yellow beef, dry pot prawns and steamed sea bass.

intro_zh: 文记 Man Kee 位于 Schöneberg，菜单覆盖红油抄手、红油饺子、夫妻肺片、口水鸡、水煮鱼、清蒸鲈鱼、红烧肉、干锅肥肠、牛腩煲、锅包肉、烤鱼和点心。整体更偏川味家常菜和多人点菜，也可以通过外卖点到部分代表菜。
intro_en: Man Kee in Schöneberg is a Chinese restaurant with Sichuan cold dishes, spicy mains, dim sum, grilled fish pot and noodle dishes. Strong matches include wontons in chili oil, fuqi feipian, kou shui ji, water-boiled fish, steamed sea bass, braised pork belly, dry pot pork intestines, beef brisket pot, guo bao rou and xiao long bao.

intro_zh: Mao Master 帽牌冒菜位于 Kantstraße，主打自选冒菜。客人可以从牛肉、鸡肉、海鲜或素食套餐开始，再选择经典麻辣、酸汤、番茄、鸡汤、牛骨汤、冬阴功或干拌口味，适合一个人快速吃一碗川味热锅。
intro_en: Mao Master in Charlottenburg focuses on customizable maocai bowls. Guests can start from beef, chicken, seafood or vegan menu variants and choose classic spicy, pickled-cabbage, tomato, chicken, beef-bone, tom yum or dry-mix styles, making it useful for quick spicy solo meals.

intro_zh: Mao Zeit 是 Manifesto Market Potsdamer Platz 里的川味冒菜档口，主打自选冒菜碗。客人可以按蔬菜、豆腐、肉类或海鲜搭配不同汤底，适合想快速吃一碗热辣冒菜的人。
intro_en: Mao Zeit is a Sichuan-style maocai counter inside Manifesto Market at Potsdamer Platz, built around customizable bowls with vegetables, tofu, meat or seafood in hot broth. It suits a quick spicy bowl in a food-hall setting.
address: EG, Manifesto, Alte Potsdamer Str. 7, 10785 Berlin, Germany

intro_zh: 马路边是 Prenzlauer Berg 一家人气较高的中式面食小馆，菜单集中在汤面、干拌面、馄饨、水饺和煎饺。适合想吃一碗热面或简单点几份饺子小吃的日常用餐。
intro_en: Marubi is a popular Chinese noodle spot in Prenzlauer Berg, focused on noodle soups, dry noodles, wontons, boiled dumplings and pan-fried dumplings. It suits a quick hot noodle bowl or a simple dumpling meal.
cuisines_zh: ["上海馄饨", "川味面食", "饺子", "面食"]

intro_zh: 麦面馆是 Friedrichshain 的小型中式面馆，主打汤面、干拌面和几款饺子。菜单里能看到毛氏红烧肉汤面、茄子豆腐面、西安拌面和不同馅料水饺，适合快速吃一顿面食。
intro_en: May Noodles is a small Chinese noodle shop in Friedrichshain focused on soup noodles, dry mixed noodles and several dumpling options. The menu includes Mao-style braised pork noodle soup, eggplant tofu noodles, Xian-style mixed noodles and dumplings with different fillings.

intro_zh: 五月花是一家综合型中餐馆，菜单覆盖点心、川味豆腐菜、红焖和酱爆类肉菜、牛肉、鸭肉和羊肉主菜。适合多人点菜分享，也适合想吃小笼包、煎包和几道热菜的客人。
intro_en: Mayflower is a broad Chinese restaurant covering dim sum, Sichuan-style tofu dishes, braised and sauced meat dishes, beef, duck and lamb mains. It works for shared meals with several hot dishes plus xiao long bao or pan-fried buns.

intro_zh: 见一面是 Friedrichshain 的中式面馆，菜单以汤面、干拌面、油泼宽面和少量点心为主。锅贴、生煎包、虾饺、烧麦、小笼包和红油水饺也适合搭配一碗面一起点。
intro_en: Meet Noodles is a Chinese noodle shop in Friedrichshain centered on soup noodles, dry mixed noodles, youpo wide noodles and a small dim sum selection. Potstickers, shengjian bao, har gow, siu mai, xiao long bao and chili-oil dumplings work well alongside a noodle bowl.

intro_zh: 宴遇是 Wilmersdorf 的中餐馆，周末上海风格早午餐很突出，也提供偏川味的面食、点心、烧鸭、猪肉和海鲜菜。适合想吃生煎、小笼包、豆腐脑、葱油饼或几道热菜的人。
intro_en: Meet You is a Wilmersdorf Chinese restaurant with a notable Shanghai-style weekend brunch alongside Sichuan-leaning noodles, dim sum, roast duck, pork and seafood dishes. It suits diners looking for shengjian bao, xiao long bao, tofu pudding, scallion pancakes or shared hot dishes.

intro_zh: 米吧是偏台式便当和面食的小店，菜单包括鸡肉便当、素蘑菇选项、卤肉风格盖饭、干面和牛肉面。适合想快速吃一份便当、卤肉饭或台式面食的人。
intro_en: Mibap is a small Taiwanese-leaning spot for bento-style rice plates and noodles, including chicken bento, mushroom options, lu-rou-style rice, dry noodles and beef noodle soup. It suits a quick rice bowl, braised-pork-style meal or Taiwanese noodle dish.

intro_zh: Torstraße 24 的咖啡馆，菜单照片可见珍珠卡仕达、咸焦糖及咸蛋黄肉松华夫饼。
intro_en: A café at Torstraße 24 with menu photos showing boba custard, salted caramel and salted egg yolk pork floss waffles.

intro_zh: 明朝 Jannowitzbrücke 店是空间较大的中餐馆，菜单覆盖点心、北京烤鸭、川味热菜、羊肉、海鲜和蔬菜菜品。适合多人聚餐、商务用餐或想点烤鸭和几道大菜的客人。
intro_en: Ming Dynastie Jannowitzbrücke is a large Chinese restaurant covering dim sum, Peking duck, Sichuan-style hot dishes, lamb, seafood and vegetable dishes. It suits group meals, business dinners or diners looking for roast duck and several shared main dishes.

intro_zh: 明朝 West 位于 Europa-Center 附近，是大型中餐馆，菜单包括点心、北京烤鸭、川味热菜、海鲜、烧鸭和蔬菜菜品。适合在 City West 找正式中餐、烤鸭或多人聚餐。
intro_en: Ming Dynastie West is a large Chinese restaurant near Europa-Center with dim sum, Peking duck, Sichuan-style hot dishes, seafood, roast duck and vegetable dishes. It works for formal Chinese meals in City West, roast duck or group dining.

intro_zh: 明家是一家菜单较宽的中餐馆，德文菜单覆盖点心、鸡肉、鸭肉、海鲜、素菜和麻婆豆腐等常见菜。整体更适合想吃传统堂食中餐、鸭类主菜或多人点菜的客人。
intro_en: Ming Jia is a broad Chinese restaurant with a German-language menu spanning dim sum, chicken, duck, seafood, vegetarian dishes and mapo tofu. It suits familiar sit-down Chinese meals, duck mains or shared dishes for a group.

intro_zh: 大明见面 Ring Center 店是一家中式小吃店，菜单包括包子、馄饨、肉夹馍、饭类、中式主菜和几款手工面，并非专门面馆。
intro_en: MingTastic at Ring Center is a Chinese snack spot serving baozi, wontons, roujiamo, rice dishes, Chinese mains and several handmade noodle dishes rather than operating as a dedicated noodle house.

intro_zh: Miss Wu 是一家偏现代小盘路线的中餐馆，菜单包括中式 tapas、点心、鸭肉菜、海鲜、面食和素菜特色。适合想点几样小菜分享，或吃一顿稍轻松的现代中餐。
intro_en: Miss Wu is a modern Chinese restaurant with a small-plate feel, covering Chinese tapas, dim sum, duck dishes, seafood, noodles and vegetarian options. It suits sharing several small dishes or having a relaxed modern Chinese meal.

intro_zh: 米祖米线位于 Wedding，菜单以鸡肉、牛肉、海鲜和素食米线为主，包括清汤、红烧、过桥米线和干拌米线，并提供汽锅鸡汤与汽锅萝卜牛肉汤。
intro_en: Mizu is a Yunnan rice-noodle house in Wedding serving clear and braised chicken, beef, seafood and vegetarian noodle soups, Guoqiao specialties, dry rice noodles and Yunnan steam-pot soups.

intro_zh: 供应蛋糕卷、肉松小贝和港式奶茶，也可提前预订整条蛋糕卷。
intro_en: Cake rolls, pork floss cakes and Hong Kong milk tea, with whole cake rolls available by advance order.

intro_zh: Mr. Liu 是一家综合型中餐馆，菜单包括自制面食、点心、脆皮鸡鸭、川味酱汁菜，以及中文菜单里的肉类和蔬菜主菜。适合想吃面点、小吃或几道热菜分享的客人。
intro_en: Mr. Liu is a broad Chinese restaurant with house-style noodles, dim sum, crispy chicken and duck, Sichuan-style sauces, meat dishes and vegetable mains. It suits noodle snacks, small dishes or several hot dishes to share.

intro_zh: 陈香贵 Friedrichshain 分店是中式面馆，重点是兰州风格牛肉面、biang biang 面变体、肉夹馍和烤串。适合想吃一碗热汤牛肉面、宽面或简单小吃的人。
intro_en: Chen Xianggui Friedrichshain is a Chinese noodle shop focused on Lanzhou-style beef noodles, biang-biang noodle variants, roujiamo and skewers. It suits a hot beef noodle soup, wide noodles or simple snacks.
cuisines_en: ["Lanzhou hand-pulled noodles", "biangbiang noodles", "beef noodle soup", "Chinese noodle house"]

intro_zh: 陈香贵 Wedding 分店是中式面馆，重点是兰州风格牛肉面、biang biang 面变体、肉夹馍和烤串。适合在 Wedding 附近快速吃一碗牛肉面、宽面或配几样小吃。
intro_en: Chen Xianggui Wedding is a Chinese noodle shop focused on Lanzhou-style beef noodles, biang-biang noodle variants, roujiamo and skewers. It suits a quick beef noodle soup, wide noodles or a few snacks around Wedding.
cuisines_en: ["Lanzhou hand-pulled noodles", "biangbiang noodles", "beef noodle soup", "Chinese noodle house"]

intro_zh: Munchy 是 Neukölln 的清真中式快餐小店，菜单中的“麻辣烫”是羊肉、牛肉或豆腐的固定搭配热锅碗，并非自选称重模式。
intro_en: Munchy is a halal Chinese quick-service spot in Neukölln. Its malatang-labelled hot pot bowls use fixed combinations of lamb, beef or tofu rather than a self-select format.

intro_zh: N Noodles & Tea 是一家紧凑的中式面馆，主打重庆风格面碗，并可调整辣度。适合想快速吃一碗小面、辣味面食或简单中式午餐的人。
intro_en: N Noodles & Tea is a compact Chinese noodle shop focused on Chongqing-style noodle bowls with adjustable spice levels. It suits a quick bowl of xiaomian, spicy noodles or a simple Chinese lunch.
cuisines_zh: ["重庆小面", "川味面食", "中式面馆"]

intro_zh: 新五洲饭店是传统德式中餐馆，菜单包括炸馄饨、馄饨汤、印尼风格炒饭炒面，以及猪肉、鸡肉、牛肉和鸭肉主菜。适合想吃熟悉型中餐、外带或家庭聚餐的人。
intro_en: Neu Wuzhou is a traditional German-Chinese restaurant with fried wontons, wonton soup, Indonesian-style fried rice and noodles, plus pork, chicken, beef and duck mains. It suits familiar Chinese restaurant dishes, takeaway or family meals.

intro_zh: 您好火锅位于 Charlottenburg，主打自助火锅和多种锅底，适合朋友聚餐和多人围桌用餐。菜单中也有叉烧包、小笼包、虾饺、蒸饺等点心，适合想在火锅之外搭配小吃的客人。
intro_en: Nin Hao is a Chinese hotpot restaurant in Charlottenburg built around an all-you-can-eat hotpot format with several broth choices. It also offers a compact dim sum selection, including char siu bao, xiao long bao, har gow, and steamed dumplings.

intro_zh: 倪记位于 Mitte/Hackescher Markt 一带，菜单以上海风格点心和手工面食为核心。招牌大汤包、小笼包、烧卖、油泼面、炸酱面和红油抄手是比较有辨识度的选择，同时也提供麻婆豆腐、水煮牛肉、回锅肉等热菜。
intro_en: Ni's Restaurant is a Chinese restaurant near Hackescher Markt with a strong focus on Shanghai-style dim sum and handmade noodles. The menu is especially recognizable for mega tang bao, xiao long bao, shao mai, youpo mian, zhajiang mian, and chili-oil wontons, alongside regional hot dishes such as mapo tofu, Sichuan boiled beef, and hui guo rou.

intro_zh: No.98 中餐厅位于 Lietzenburger Str. 98，菜单包含 74.90 欧元、桌边片制并配薄饼的北京烤鸭，也供应香酥鸭、冒烤鸭及川湘口味热菜、海鲜和素菜。
intro_en: No.98 Restaurant on Lietzenburger Str. 98 serves a €74.90 Peking duck, filleted tableside and served with pancakes, alongside crispy duck, duck in spicy broth, Sichuan- and Hunan-style mains, seafood and vegetarian dishes.
cuisines_zh: ["中式综合", "川菜", "湘菜", "热炒", "海鲜", "素食"]

intro_zh: Noodle Plus 位于 Mitte，菜单以面食和点心为核心：担担面、拌面、麻酱面、红烧牛肉面、雪菜肉丝面和米粉汤是主要方向，同时有红油馄饨、虾饺、烧卖、煎饺等自制点心。想吃一碗热汤面、干拌面或搭配小点心时，这家店的选择比较集中。
intro_en: Noodle Plus is a Chinese noodle restaurant in Mitte built around noodle bowls, noodle soups, rice noodle soups, and homemade dumplings. The menu highlights dandan mian, dry noodles, sesame peanut noodles, braised beef noodle soup, pork-and-preserved-vegetable noodle soup, wontons in chili oil, har gow, siu mai, and fried jiaozi.

intro_zh: 想见面位于 Wilmersdorf，菜单以面食为核心，既有牛肉汤面、红烧牛肉汤面、豆腐汤面，也有油泼面、炸酱面、担担面和 𰻝𰻝面等干拌或宽面选项。小吃部分有红油抄手、馄饨汤、锅贴、小笼包和虾饺，适合想吃一碗面再配点心的日常用餐。
intro_en: Noodle Point is a Chinese noodle restaurant in Wilmersdorf centered on soup noodles, dry noodles, and Biangbiang-style wide noodles. The menu includes beef noodle soup, braised beef noodle soup, tofu noodle soup, youpo mian, zhajiang mian, tantan noodles, chili-oil wontons, gyoza, xiao long bao, and har gow.

intro_zh: Panda Garden 位于 Hermsdorf，是典型的社区型德式中餐馆。菜单以 Nasi Goreng、杂碎、豆腐菜和脆皮鸭为主，口味和菜式都偏传统外卖/家庭聚餐型，适合想吃经典中餐简餐或脆皮鸭的客人。
intro_en: Panda Garden is a neighborhood Chinese restaurant in Hermsdorf with a classic German-style Chinese menu. The menu centers on nasi goreng, chop suey, tofu dishes, and crispy duck, making it more suitable for familiar takeaway-style Chinese meals and family dinners than for regional specialty dining.

intro_zh: Panda II 位于 Rudow，是典型的社区型德式中餐馆，菜单很大，但主线集中在脆皮鸭、点心、咕噜肉、回锅肉、牛肉和虾类热菜。适合家庭聚餐、多人点菜或想吃经典德式中餐风格的客人。
intro_en: Panda II is a neighborhood German-style Chinese restaurant in Rudow with a broad family-oriented menu. The strongest menu anchors are crispy duck, dim sum, gu lao rou, hui guo rou, beef stir-fries, prawns, hot plates, and familiar sweet-sour or spicy sauces.

intro_zh: Panda Meister Halensee 是以饺子、包子和手工面为核心的现代中式快餐小店。菜单重点很清楚：水饺、煎饺、红油饺子、牛肉汤面、炸酱面、担担面、油泼面和包子，适合快速午餐、外带或简单晚餐。
intro_en: Panda Meister Halensee is a casual Chinese spot focused on dumplings, baozi, and handmade noodles. The menu centers on boiled and pan-fried dumplings, chili-oil dumplings, beef noodle soup, zhajiang mian, dandan mian, youpo mian, and baozi, making it well suited to quick lunches, takeaway, and simple dinners.

intro_zh: Panda Meister Moabit 是以水饺、煎饺、包子和面食为核心的中式快餐小店。菜单集中在饺子、牛肉汤面、炸酱面、拌面、卤肉饭和麻婆豆腐，适合快速午餐、外带或简单晚餐。
intro_en: Panda Meister Moabit is a casual Chinese spot centered on boiled dumplings, pan-fried dumplings, baozi, noodles, and simple rice plates. The menu is strongest for dumplings, beef noodle soup, zhajiang mian, ban mian, lu rou fan, and mapo tofu.

intro_zh: Panda Meister Ostbahnhof 是车站附近的中式快餐小店，核心是水饺、煎饺、包子和面食，也有卤肉饭、麻婆豆腐、甜酸鸡肉和地锅鸡等简餐选择。整体适合赶车前后快速用餐、外带或工作日午餐。
intro_en: Panda Meister Ostbahnhof is a casual Chinese spot near the station, focused on boiled dumplings, pan-fried dumplings, baozi, noodles, and quick rice plates. The menu also includes lu rou fan, mapo tofu, sweet-and-sour chicken, and di guo ji for a more filling meal.

intro_zh: 太和饭殿位于 Mitte，核心招牌是北京烤鸭，同时菜单也覆盖麻婆豆腐、宫保鸡丁、孜然羊肉、红烧肉、鱼香肉丝和多种点心。它更适合多人聚餐、商务餐或专门想吃烤鸭的一餐，而不是只点一份快餐。
intro_en: Peking Ente Berlin is a Mitte Chinese restaurant anchored by Peking duck, with a broader menu of Beijing-style dishes, Sichuan classics, dim sum, seafood, and shareable plates. It is best suited to group meals, business dinners, and dedicated Peking duck meals rather than a simple quick bite.

intro_zh: Peking Perle 位于 Spandau，菜单主线是北京鸭、四川火锅、各类鸭菜和川味热炒。除了北京鸭和火锅，也能点到水煮牛肉、宫保鸡丁、鱼香茄子、干煸四季豆、回锅肉等常见川菜，适合家庭聚餐或多人点菜。
intro_en: Peking Perle is a Chinese restaurant in Spandau centered on Peking duck, Sichuan hot pot, crispy duck dishes, and Sichuan-style wok dishes. Alongside duck and hot pot, the menu includes Sichuan boiled beef, gongbao chicken, yu xiang eggplant, dry-fried green beans, and hui guo rou, making it suitable for family meals and group ordering.

intro_zh: 凤凰酒楼是 Prenzlauer Berg 的大型亚洲自助餐厅，核心卖点是午餐/晚餐自助、寿司、海鲜和现场铁板烧。它适合家庭聚餐、朋友聚会或想一次吃到很多品类的人，而不是以某一道单品取胜的小馆。
intro_en: Phönix Buffet is a large Asian buffet restaurant in Prenzlauer Berg focused on lunch and dinner buffet formats, sushi, seafood, live teppanyaki grill, and crispy duck. It is best suited to family meals, group dinners, and diners who want many categories in one meal.

intro_zh: Pong's 是 Tegel 一带的社区型中餐厅，环境偏传统堂食，适合家庭或多人聚餐。菜单重点包括香酥鸭、铁板三鲜、四川鸡、麻婆豆腐、鱼香茄子和几道带甜辣或花生酱风味的招牌菜。
intro_en: Pong's is a neighborhood Chinese restaurant in Tegel with a classic dine-in feel. The menu is strongest for crispy duck, sizzling mixed dishes, Sichuan chicken, mapo tofu, yu-xiang eggplant, and several house specials with sweet-chili or peanut sauce flavors.

intro_zh: Prince（太子）主打现代粤式点心和烧腊，也加入一些马来西亚风味热菜。适合想吃小笼包、虾饺、烧卖、流沙包、北京烤鸭、烧鸭和精致中式主菜的用餐场景，整体比传统中餐馆更适合约会和朋友聚餐。
intro_en: Prince is a modern Cantonese restaurant in Mitte built around dim sum, roast meats, and a few Chinese-Malaysian main dishes. It works well for xiao long bao, har gow, siu mai, salted egg lava bao, Peking duck, roast duck, and polished Chinese plates in a more contemporary dining setting.
cuisines_zh: ["粤式点心", "粤菜", "马来西亚风味中餐"]

intro_zh: Regent 是 Kladow 一带的老派德式中餐馆，适合家庭聚餐和想吃大份主菜的人。菜单重点是香酥鸭、甜酸炸鸡和炸鱼、宫保大虾、铁板豆豉牛肉，以及四川、泰式咖喱和香辣做法的主菜。
intro_en: Regent is a classic neighborhood Chinese restaurant in Kladow, best suited for family meals and generous main dishes. The stronger menu signals are crispy duck, sweet-and-sour fried chicken or fish, Kung Pao prawns, sizzling beef in black bean sauce, and spicy Szechuan, Thai curry, or Xiang-Lak style stir-fries.

intro_zh: Reuter Terrassen 是 Britz 一带空间较大的老派中餐厅，适合家庭聚餐、多人聚会和想要稳定德式中餐的人。菜单重点包括多种香酥鸭、四川牛肉、宫保鸡丁、鱼香肉丝、泰式咖喱和海鲜主菜，整体走大份量、选择多的路线。
intro_en: Reuter Terrassen is a large, classic Chinese restaurant in Britz, useful for family meals, group dinners, and familiar German-Chinese comfort dishes. The menu is strongest for crispy duck variations, Szechuan beef, Kung Pao chicken, yu-xiang pork strips, Thai curry dishes, and seafood mains.

intro_zh: Rong's Noodlehouse 是 Leibnizstraße 附近很小而专注的中式面馆，菜单集中在牛肉汤面、红油牛肉拌面、红油豆腐拌面和猪肉包。适合想快速吃一碗热面或简单面食的人。
intro_en: Rong's Noodlehouse is a small, focused Chinese noodle shop near Leibnizstraße. The menu centers on beef noodle soup, chili-oil dry noodles with beef or tofu, and pork bao, making it best for a quick bowl of noodles or a simple casual meal.

intro_zh: 玫瑰苑是一家综合型中餐馆，重点不是单一小吃，而是适合多人分享的北京烤鸭、双椒鲈鱼、铁板大虾、点心和几道川味主菜。适合家庭聚餐、朋友聚餐或想吃烤鸭套餐的人。
intro_en: Rosengarten is a broad Chinese restaurant in Schmargendorf with a stronger focus on shareable dishes such as Peking duck, sea bass with mixed chilis, teppanyaki prawns, dim sum, and Sichuan-style mains. It works best for family meals, group dinners, or anyone specifically looking for a Peking duck menu.

intro_zh: 红豆中餐馆 Charlottenburg 店更偏北方面点和家常小馆，适合吃包子、饺子、馄饨面、牛肉面、碗杂面、麻辣烫和卤肉饭这类直接、饱腹的菜。整体不是精致宴请路线，而是适合日常快速吃饭和想吃面点的人。
intro_en: Rotbohnen in Charlottenburg is a casual Chinese snack and dumpling spot with a northern home-style feel. The strongest choices are bao, boiled or pan-fried dumplings, wonton noodles, beef noodle soup, wanza noodles, malatang, and braised pork rice.

intro_zh: 红豆中餐馆 Friedrichshain 店延续北方面点和家常小馆路线，菜单集中在包子、饺子、馄饨面、麻辣小面、碗杂面、麻辣烫、卤肉饭和地三鲜。适合日常快速吃饭，也适合想吃手工饺子和面食的人。
intro_en: Rotbohnen in Friedrichshain is a casual Chinese snack and dumpling spot with a northern home-style feel. The strongest choices are bao, boiled or pan-fried dumplings, wonton noodles, mala noodles, wanza noodles, malatang, braised pork rice, and three treasures of the earth.

intro_zh: Royal Garden 是 Lichterfelde 一带的大型中式自助餐厅，重点在午市自助、蒙古自助、香酥鸭、寿司和海鲜选择。它更适合家庭聚餐、多人聚会和想要一次吃多种热菜与自助选择的人。
intro_en: Royal Garden is a large Chinese buffet restaurant in Lichterfelde. Its main draw is the lunch buffet, Mongolian buffet, crispy duck, sushi, and seafood selection, making it useful for family meals and larger group dinners.

intro_zh: Royal Gourmet 当前可确认的菜单更偏德式中餐午餐路线，重点是香酥鸭、甜酸炸鱼柳、咖喱香酥鸡、宫保牛肉和几道配蔬菜的肉类主菜。适合想在 Britz 一带吃稳定、熟悉口味中餐午餐的人。
intro_en: Royal Gourmet currently has a clear German-Chinese lunch-menu profile, centered on crispy duck, sweet-and-sour fried fish fillet, curry crispy chicken, Kung Pao-style beef, and meat dishes with vegetables. It fits a casual lunch or familiar comfort-food meal in Britz.

intro_zh: 如意轩火锅店的重点是火锅锅底选择，包含牛油辣锅、番茄锅、菌菇锅、花胶鸡锅和老鸭锅，也支持鸳鸯锅和三拼锅。它更适合多人围炉吃火锅，而不是普通单人快餐。
intro_en: Ruyixuan is a Chinese hotpot restaurant in Friedrichshain built around broth choices: spicy beef tallow, tomato, mushroom, fish maw chicken, and old duck broth, with split-pot and triple-pot formats for groups.

intro_zh: Friedrichshain 这家三顾冒菜主打自选食材加锅底的冒菜模式，适合想按自己口味搭一碗麻辣或不辣热汤菜的人。锅底包括经典川味、木姜子、三鲜和老坛酸菜，整体更适合快速正餐和一个人吃。
intro_en: Sanku Maots'ai in Friedrichshain is built around customizable maocai bowls: choose ingredients, pick a broth, and get a hot Sichuan-style bowl. The broth choices include O.G. Szechuan, tropical Thai, three-fresh, and pickled mustard green.

intro_zh: Mitte 这家三顾冒菜主打自选食材加锅底的冒菜模式，位置更靠市中心，适合上班族、游客或一个人快速吃一碗热汤菜。锅底包括经典川味、木姜子、三鲜和老坛酸菜。
intro_en: Sanku Maots'ai in Mitte is a quick maocai spot built around customizable hot bowls and broth choices. Its central location makes it useful for office workers, visitors, or solo meals near Friedrichstraße, with O.G. Szechuan, tropical Thai, three-fresh, and pickled mustard green broth options.

intro_zh: 东吴 Seepalast 位于 Rahnsdorf，菜单覆盖中式和亚洲风味菜品，包含云吞汤、北京鸭卷、脆皮鸭炒面、宫保鸡丁、八宝鸭和多种经典热炒。
intro_en: Seepalast in Rahnsdorf serves a broad Chinese and Asian menu with wonton soup, Peking duck rolls, fried noodles with crispy duck, Gong Bao chicken, Ba-Bao duck and classic wok dishes.

intro_zh: Wilmersdorf 的山海记供应霸王牛骨面、上海生煎和锅贴，还有酱香饼、锅盔与江南风味汤面。
intro_en: Shan Hai Ji in Wilmersdorf serves beef-bone noodles, Shanghai pan-fried buns and potstickers, alongside jiang xiang bing, guokui flatbreads and Jiangnan-style noodle soups.

intro_zh: 上海饭店更像一间社区型中餐正餐馆，菜单不只限于上海菜，也有饺子、红烧肉、回锅肉、烤鸭、水煮牛、水煮鱼和酸菜鱼。适合想吃热菜和饺子的一顿日常中餐。
intro_en: Chinarestaurant Shanghai in Friedrichshain is a neighborhood Chinese restaurant rather than a narrow Shanghai-specialty shop. The menu covers dumplings, red-braised pork, twice-cooked pork, roast duck, Sichuan boiled beef, Sichuan boiled fish, and pickled-cabbage fish.

intro_zh: 傻妞面馆 Friedrichshain 店不只是面馆，也有煎饼、红油抄手、锅包肉、宫保鸡、麻婆豆腐和几道家常热菜。它适合想吃中式面食、煎饼或几道川味家常菜的日常用餐。
intro_en: Shaniu's House of Noodles 3 is broader than a pure noodle shop: it also offers jianbing, wontons in chili oil, guo bao rou, Kung Pao chicken, mapo tofu, and home-style wok dishes. It is useful for a casual noodle, jianbing, or Sichuan-style comfort-food meal in Friedrichshain.

intro_zh: 傻姞面馆 Tiergarten 店是傻姞体系里更综合的一家，重点包括广西米粉、烧鸭饭、石锅米线、自助火锅、冒菜锅、红油抄手和几道中式小炒。它更适合想吃米粉、热锅或多人随便点一桌的日常场景。
intro_en: Shaniu's House of Noodles 2 in Tiergarten is a broader casual Chinese spot with Guangxi rice noodles, roast duck rice, hot-stone rice noodles, hotpot buffet, maocai pots, wontons in chili oil, and several wok dishes.

intro_zh: 傻妞面馆 Wilmersdorf 店以面食、饺子和馄饨为核心，也提供红油抄手、凉面、卤肉饭、排骨饭和家常炒菜。菜单覆盖从小笼包、虾饺到麻婆豆腐、鱼香茄子、酸菜鱼等熟悉中式菜品，适合想吃一顿直接、热闹、选择较多的家常中餐。
intro_en: Shaniu's House of Noodles in Wilmersdorf is a casual Chinese noodle house built around noodles, dumplings and wontons, with dishes such as chili-oil wontons, cold noodles, braised pork rice, pork ribs, mapo tofu, yu xiang eggplant and pickled-mustard fish. It works best for a straightforward everyday Chinese meal with plenty of familiar choices.

intro_zh: 傻妞便利店 / Shaniu's Bistro 更像一个市场小食店，菜单把中式点心、煎饼、面/粉和韩式拌饭、紫菜卷放在一起。适合早餐、早午餐或顺路吃一顿快餐，重点菜品包括小笼包、虾饺、生煎包、红油抄手、煎饼、牛肉面和拌饭。
intro_en: Shaniu's Market/Bistro is a small Wilmersdorf counter spot combining Chinese dim sum, jianbing, noodle or rice-noodle bowls and Korean-style quick meals. It is best suited to breakfast, brunch, takeaway or a simple casual meal, with items such as xiao long bao, har gow, shengjian bao, chili-oil wontons, jianbing, beef noodles and bibimbap.

intro_zh: 珊珊小屋是 Prenzlauer Berg 一家偏南京、江苏和淮扬风味的中餐馆。新菜单既有炸酱面、牛肉面、包子、煎饺和点心，也有南京盐水鸭、红烧肉、毛血旺、珊珊三鲜大锅巴等正餐与每日特选；松鼠鲤鱼、扬州狮子头、南京老鸭煲和江宁肚包鸡等菜需提前预订。
intro_en: Shanshan is a Prenzlauer Berg Chinese restaurant with a Nanjing, Jiangsu and Huaiyang leaning. Its current menu spans noodles, baozi, dumplings and dim sum, alongside Nanjing salted duck, red-braised pork belly, Mao Xue Wang and house crispy rice. Regional dishes such as Songshu carp, Yangzhou lion head meatballs, Nanjing old duck stew and Jiangning chicken require advance ordering.

intro_zh: 山西面馆以刀削面为招牌，同时提供煎饺、虾饺、小笼包等点心，以及宫保鸡丁、辣子鸡、水煮牛肉、水煮鱼、麻婆豆腐、毛血旺和干锅菜。它更像一间面馆加川味热菜的小馆，适合想吃手工面、饺子或重口味家常菜的一餐。
intro_en: Shanxi Nudelhaus in Friedrichshain is built around Shanxi knife-cut noodles, with handmade pan-fried jiaozi, dim sum and a broad set of Sichuan-style hot dishes. Alongside dao xiao mian, the menu includes gong bao chicken, la zi ji, Sichuan boiled beef, boiled fish, mapo tofu, mao xue wang and dry-pot dishes.

intro_zh: 食坊居是一家主打淮扬/江苏并兼有川湘菜线索的中餐馆，菜单里有盐水鸭、清炖狮子头、扬州煲，也有红油抄手、小笼汤包、口水鸡、鱼香肉丝、湘式小炒牛肉、辣子鸡、水煮牛肉和北京片鸭。它适合想在市中心吃一顿选择丰富的中餐，也适合多人点菜分享。
intro_en: Shifang House in Charlottenburg is led by Huaiyang/Jiangsu and Sichuan lines, with salted duck, lion head meatballs and Yangzhou pot alongside dim sum, homemade dumplings, chili-oil wontons, spicy hot dishes, Peking duck and steamed sea bass. It works well for a casual shared meal with both mild and spicy options.

intro_zh: 小龙坎是 Charlottenburg 的川味火锅店，核心是牛油红锅、番茄锅、菌菇锅以及双拼、三拼锅底。菜单还包括小龙坎牛肉、双椒牛肉、牛肉串、小酥肉、红糖糍粑、火锅拉面和川粉，更适合多人聚餐和想吃正统火锅氛围的一餐。
intro_en: ShooLoongKan HotPot in Charlottenburg is a Sichuan hotpot restaurant built around spicy beef-tallow broth, tomato broth, mushroom broth and split-pot combinations. The menu also includes XiaoLongKan beef, double-chili beef, beef skewers, crispy pork, brown-sugar rice cakes, handmade hotpot noodles and sweet-potato noodles, making it most suitable for group hotpot meals.

intro_zh: 蜀味坊是一家以川菜和重口味热菜为核心的 Kreuzberg 中餐馆，菜单里有麻婆豆腐、水煮牛肉、沸腾水煮鱼、回锅肉、鱼香肉丝、宫保鸡丁、辣子鸡、干锅肥肠、干锅香辣猪手和凤爪肥肠煲。这里更适合想吃辣、想点几道川味主菜分享的一餐。
intro_en: Shu Wei Fang - Szechuan House in Kreuzberg focuses on Sichuan hot dishes such as mapo tofu, Sichuan boiled beef, boiled fish, twice-cooked pork, yu xiang shredded pork, gong bao chicken, la zi ji, dry-pot pork intestines, spicy pig trotters and chicken feet with pork intestines. It is best for a shared spicy Chinese meal.

intro_zh: 四川饭店是 Steglitz 一家以川菜为核心的中餐馆，菜单重点包括夫妻肺片、口水鸡、农家小炒肉、麻婆豆腐、鱼香肉丝、重庆辣子鸡、水煮牛肉、诸葛烤鱼、干锅肥肠、虎皮尖椒和酸辣粉。它比普通综合中餐馆更偏向川味冷菜、干锅、烤鱼和麻辣热菜。
intro_en: China Restaurant Sichuan in Steglitz focuses on Sichuan cooking, with dishes such as fuqi feipian, mouth-watering chicken, farmhouse stir-fried pork belly, mapo tofu, yu xiang shredded pork, Chongqing la zi ji, Sichuan boiled beef, grilled fish, dry-pot pork intestines, tiger-skin peppers and sour-spicy sweet potato noodles.

intro_zh: Sonne 新阳光大酒店位于 Charlottenburg，菜单重点集中在火锅和偏川味的大菜，如口水鸡、水煮牛肉、毛血旺、剁椒鱼头和麻辣烫。它适合想吃火锅、辣味热菜或多人分享中餐的场景。
intro_en: Sonne in Charlottenburg is a Chinese restaurant with hot pot and Sichuan-leaning specialties at the center of the menu, including koushui chicken, Sichuan boiled beef, Mao Xue Wang, chopped-chili fish head, and malatang-style dishes. It works best for group meals and diners looking for spicy shared plates.

intro_zh: Sun Wah 是 Tegel 一带的老派中餐馆，菜单以德式中餐结构为主，鸭类主菜、猪肉、牛肉、虾和豆腐菜都比较完整。它更适合想吃传统社区中餐、脆皮鸭和多人分享主菜的场景。
intro_en: Sun Wah is a classic neighborhood Chinese restaurant in Tegel with a broad German-Chinese menu. Duck dishes are a clear focus, alongside pork, beef, prawns, and tofu mains, making it a practical choice for familiar shared plates and casual group meals.

intro_zh: Sùsù Vegan Food 是 Prenzlauer Berg 的纯素中式小店，菜单集中在川味灵感的拌面、担担面、素水饺、盖饭和凉粉类小吃。它适合想吃辣味纯素中餐、面食或轻量外带餐的人。
intro_en: Sùsù Vegan Food is a vegan Chinese spot in Prenzlauer Berg built around Sichuan-inspired noodles, dumplings, rice bowls, and spicy small plates such as liangfen and sour-spicy glass noodles. It is a good fit for vegan diners looking for bold, casual Chinese flavors.

intro_zh: Szechuan Küche / 椒点私厨位于 Wedding，菜单以川味热菜为主，水煮牛肉、辣子鸡、麻婆豆腐、鱼香茄子、酸菜鱼和孜然羊肉都在核心位置。它适合想吃辣味中餐、点几道菜分享，或补充饺子、豆腐和素菜的人。
intro_en: Szechuan Küche in Wedding focuses on Sichuan-style Chinese dishes such as Sichuan boiled beef, la zi ji, mapo tofu, Yu-Xiang eggplant, suan cai yu, and cumin lamb. It is best for diners looking for spicy shared plates, with dumplings, tofu, vegetarian dishes, fish, lamb, and prawns also covered.

intro_zh: Tai Lee 是 Marienfelde 的老派中餐馆，菜单覆盖饺子、包子、烧卖、脆皮鸭、铁板菜、罗勒炒肉、大虾、鱼和豆腐素菜。它更适合家庭聚餐、多人分享和想吃传统德式中餐大菜单的人。
intro_en: Tai Lee is a classic Chinese restaurant in Marienfelde with a broad menu covering dumplings, baozi, siu mai, crispy duck, sizzling plates, basil stir-fries, prawns, fish, and tofu dishes. It suits family meals and groups looking for a familiar German-Chinese menu.

intro_zh: Tak Kee 德记偏港式粤菜，黑板菜单上能看到蒸鱼、鸡煲、大虾粉丝煲、赛螃蟹、椒盐牛柳粒和周末脆皮烧肉等菜。它更适合想找柏林少见的港式家常热菜、烧腊风味和粤菜小馆氛围的人。
intro_en: Tak Kee leans toward Hong Kong-style Cantonese cooking, with chalkboard specials such as steamed fish, mala chicken clay pot, prawn vermicelli pot, mock crab with scallops and prawns, salt-and-pepper beef cubes, and weekend crispy roast pork. It fits diners looking for Cantonese home-style specials in Berlin.

intro_zh: Tangs Kantine 位于 Kreuzberg，菜单不只是“食堂式”简餐，而是覆盖点心、川味热菜、面类特色、鱼虾、羊肉煲和豆腐素菜的综合中餐馆。小笼包、锅贴、夫妻肺片、回锅肉、麻婆豆腐、重庆小面和酸豆角肉末面都适合重点关注。
intro_en: Tangs Kantine in Kreuzberg is a broad Chinese restaurant rather than a simple canteen, with dim sum, Sichuan-style mains, noodle specialties, fish, prawns, lamb, clay pots, tofu dishes, and selected Chinese desserts. Xiao long bao, guo tie, fuqi feipian, twice-cooked pork, mapo tofu, Chongqing noodles, and dry noodles with pickled beans are useful anchors.

intro_zh: 摊摊豆花位于 Markthalle Neun，菜单很集中，核心是四川风味豆花和几款面食。摊摊豆花、豆花面、燃面、葱油面和枸杞甜豆花构成了主要选择，适合想吃轻量四川小吃、豆花或简洁面食的人。
intro_en: Tantan Douhua is a focused Sichuan snack stall in Markthalle Neun built around douhua and a short noodle menu. Tantan douhua, douhua noodles, Yibin ranmian, scallion oil noodles, and sweet douhua with goji berries are the main anchors.

intro_zh: 桃园面馆位于 Charlottenburg，菜单重点是中式面食和手工饺子。兰州牛肉面、油泼面、重庆小面、炸酱面、扁面、麻酱面、红油抄手、肉夹馍和多种煎饺构成了主要选择，适合想吃面馆型中餐的人。
intro_en: Tao Yuan Noodlehouse in Charlottenburg focuses on Chinese noodles and handmade dumplings. Lanzhou-style beef noodles, Youpo Mian, Chongqing Xiaomian, Zhajiang Mian, wide noodles, sesame paste noodles, wontons in chili oil, rou jia mo, and pan-fried dumplings define the menu.

intro_zh: 茶点屋位于 Friedrichshain，菜单重点是手工饺子、云吞、面食和几款馍/饼。猪肉白菜饺、牛肉西芹饺、虾饺、烧卖、酸辣云吞、红烧牛肉面、酸辣红薯粉和汤圆都比较突出，适合想吃饺子面食类中餐的人。
intro_en: Teegebäck-Haus in Friedrichshain is built around handmade dumplings, wontons, noodles, flatbread-style buns, duck rolls, and tang yuan. Pork cabbage dumplings, beef celery dumplings, har gow, siu mai, chili-oil wontons, beef noodle soup, suan la fen, and tang yuan are useful anchors.

intro_en: Ten Seconds is a Yunnan rice-noodle house in Charlottenburg. Its menu spans classic, tomato, hot-and-sour, spicy, kimchi and green-Sichuan-pepper soups, plus hot-bowl and dry rice-noodle dishes.

intro_zh: The Butterfly Lovers 是一家完整的纯素中餐馆，菜单覆盖担担面、水饺、锅贴、小笼包、麻婆豆腐、鱼香茄子、地三鲜、干锅花菜、酸辣宽粉和多种仿荤主菜。它适合想吃一整顿纯素中餐，而不是只吃轻食沙拉的人。
intro_en: The Butterfly Lovers is a full vegan Chinese restaurant with dan dan mian, dumplings, guo tie, xiao long bao, mapo tofu, Yu-Xiang eggplant, Di San Xian, dry-pot cauliflower, suan la fen, vegan duck, vegan pork-style dishes, and tang yuan. It is a strong fit for diners looking for a complete plant-based Chinese meal.

intro_zh: The Noodle Town Mitte 菜单很集中，核心是 𰻝𰻝面、草本汤面和几款饺子。豆腐、茄子和牛肉口味的 𰻝𰻝面是主线，另有小笼包、鲜虾饺和较温和的草本汤面，适合想快速吃一碗手工面的人。
intro_en: The Noodle Town Mitte has a compact menu centered on biangbiang-style noodles, mild herbal noodle soups, and dumplings. Tofu, eggplant, and beef biangbiang noodles are the main anchors, alongside xiao long bao, prawn dumplings, and softer herbal noodle soups.

intro_zh: The Noodle Town X-Berg 延续同一套紧凑面馆菜单，核心是 𰻝𰻝面、草本汤面和几款饺子。豆腐、茄子和牛肉口味的 𰻝𰻝面是主线，另有小笼包、鲜虾饺和较温和的草本汤面，适合在 Bergmannkiez 快速吃一碗手工面。
intro_en: The Noodle Town X-Berg keeps the same compact noodle-house menu built around biangbiang-style noodles, mild herbal noodle soups, and dumplings. Tofu, eggplant, and beef biangbiang noodles are the main anchors, alongside xiao long bao, prawn dumplings, and softer herbal noodle soups.

intro_zh: The Tree Noodle House 是 Brunnenstraße 上的创意中式面馆，菜名有自己的命名体系，但核心仍是川味拌面和抄手。麻婆豆腐面、麻酱拌面、豌杂面、担担面、鱼香肉丁面、辣鸡面和干拌抄手是主要方向，适合想吃偏辣拌面的人。
intro_en: The Tree Noodle House on Brunnenstraße is a creative Chinese noodle shop built around Sichuan-style dry noodles and chaoshou. Mapo tofu noodles, sesame peanut noodles, Wan Za noodles, dan dan noodles, Yu-Xiang pork noodles, spicy chicken noodles, and dry-mixed chaoshou define the menu.

intro_zh: 天府酒家是柏林 Wilmersdorf 一带较有辨识度的川菜馆，菜单覆盖口水鸡、夫妻肺片、宫保鸡丁、水煮鱼、重庆烤鱼、回锅肉、鱼香肉丝和水煮牛肉等经典川菜。整体更适合想吃辣味热菜、川式冷盘或多人分享菜的客人。
intro_en: Tian Fu is a long-running Sichuan restaurant in Wilmersdorf, with a menu built around chili-oil cold starters, classic Sichuan stir-fries, grilled fish, water-boiled fish and beef, pork belly dishes, prawns, tofu, and vegetables. It is a good fit for diners looking for spicy Sichuan dishes and shareable Chinese mains.

intro_zh: 天府子主打素食和纯素友好的川菜，把麻婆豆腐、鱼香茄子、干锅花菜、干煸四季豆、担担面、酸辣粉以及素鸭、素鸡、素虾等替代菜做成完整菜单。它更适合想吃川味素菜、辣味豆腐和多人分享素食中餐的客人。
intro_en: Tianfuzius is a vegetarian and vegan-friendly Sichuan restaurant in Schöneberg. The menu focuses on tofu, eggplant, dry-pot vegetables, dan dan noodles, hot-and-sour sweet potato noodles, dumplings, and vegan alternatives such as vegan duck, chicken, prawns, and squid. It is a strong fit for diners looking for spicy vegetarian Sichuan food and shareable Chinese dishes.

intro_zh: 随园听松是一家偏聚餐场景的中式火锅店，重点在麻辣牛油锅、清油麻辣锅、菌汤、番茄锅、椰子鸡和牛骨汤等锅底选择，以及牛羊肉、牛百叶、鸭血、鱼豆腐、豆腐皮和蔬菜篮等涮品。小酥肉、炸豆腐、红糖糍粑和冰粉也适合作为火锅前后搭配。
intro_en: Ting Song is a Chinese hotpot restaurant in Wilmersdorf built around broth choices, sliced meats, tofu products, vegetables, and hotpot snacks. Key items include Sichuan beef-tallow broth, vegan chili broth, mushroom broth, tomato broth, coconut chicken broth, beef and lamb add-ins, ox omasum, duck blood, crispy pork, brown sugar rice cake, and ice jelly.

intro_zh: Toca Rouge 不是传统地域中餐馆，而是偏晚餐和酒吧氛围的中式融合餐厅。菜单使用电影感和创意英文名，实际菜品以馄饨汤、炸虾馄饨、橙汁鸡、四川椒牛肉、黑椒牛柳、麻婆豆腐、鸭胸和三文鱼碗等融合菜为主，适合想吃现代中式风格而不是家常川菜的客人。
intro_en: Toca Rouge is a Chinese-fusion dinner restaurant in Mitte rather than a traditional regional Chinese spot. The menu uses playful signature names, with dishes built around wonton soup, fried shrimp wontons, orange chicken, Sichuan-pepper beef, black-pepper beef fillet, mapo tofu, duck breast, prawns, and salmon bowl. It fits date-night or group dinners where atmosphere and creative dishes matter.

intro_zh: 土龙是一家偏家常和实惠路线的中餐小馆，菜单里有红烧肉、麻婆豆腐、鱼香肉丝、鱼香茄子、回锅肉、海鲜豆腐煲和羊腩煲等老式中餐馆常见菜。它更适合想吃简单家常热菜和煲仔菜的日常午晚餐。
intro_en: Tu-Long is a casual Chinese bistro in Charlottenburg with a homestyle menu built around braised pork belly, mapo tofu, yuxiang pork, yuxiang eggplant, twice-cooked pork, seafood tofu claypot, and lamb claypot. It is better suited to an everyday Chinese meal than to a modern fine-dining setting.

intro_zh: UUU 更接近现代中餐体验菜单，而不是传统中餐小馆。官网样例菜单会随季节变化，菜式包括皮蛋烧椒、椒麻鸡、酿豆腐、炸平菇、蒸鲈鱼、花卷和创意甜品，并常与茶饮或非酒精饮品搭配。它适合特殊约会、对现代中餐感兴趣的晚餐，而不是临时吃一顿快餐。
intro_en: UUU is a small modern Chinese dining room in Wedding built around seasonal menus, tea or non-alcoholic pairings, and refined plating. The sample menu includes dishes such as pidan eggs with scorched peppers, numbing chicken, stuffed tofu, fried oyster mushrooms, steamed seabass, steamed bun, and a creative dessert. It is better understood as a special-occasion Chinese tasting experience than a casual noodle or rice spot.
cuisines_zh: ["现代中餐", "创意中餐", "体验菜单"]

intro_zh: Wan-Loi 是 Rudow 一带的社区型老牌中餐馆，菜单明显偏德式中餐和宴席式大菜。最突出的方向是鸭类和北京烤鸭，另外还有宫保鸡、宫保大虾、咕咾肉、星洲炒米、红咖喱鱼锅、三鲜豆腐锅和八宝鸭等经典餐馆菜，适合家庭聚餐或多人点菜。
intro_en: Wan-Loi is a long-running neighborhood Chinese restaurant in Rudow with a classic German-Chinese menu. Duck dishes and Peking duck are the main highlights, supported by gongbao chicken, gongbao prawns, sweet-and-sour pork, Singapore rice noodles, red curry fish pot, tofu pot, and large chef-special dishes for group meals.

intro_zh: 味道佳位于 Prenzlauer Berg，官方菜单覆盖午餐、汤羹点心、川味冷菜、家常热炒、砂锅鱼菜和预订大菜。代表菜包括鸭血粉丝汤、红油抄手、小笼包、南京盐水鸭、宫保鸡丁、水煮牛肉、毛血旺、酸菜活鱼、锅包肉和扬州狮子头，适合多人分享。
intro_en: WeiDaoJia is a Chinese restaurant in Prenzlauer Berg with an official menu spanning lunch dishes, soups and dumplings, Sichuan cold starters, homestyle stir-fries, claypot and fish dishes, and pre-order specialties. Menu anchors include duck-blood vermicelli soup, chili-oil wontons, xiao long bao, Nanjing salted duck, gongbao chicken, water-boiled beef, mao xue wang, suan cai fish, guo bao rou, and lion's head meatballs.

intro_zh: 这家 Wen Cheng Burgsdorfstraße 分店以外卖和自取为主，菜单核心是品牌的𰻝𰻝面和 Wen Cheng 招牌面。牛肉、豆腐香菇、茄子和橙汁鸡几种浇头都统一归入文成的宽面体系，另有川味炸鸡刈包、炸豆腐刈包、橙汁鸡块和鸡肉香菇白菜饺子。
intro_en: This Wen Cheng branch on Burgsdorfstraße is a delivery and pickup-oriented noodle kitchen. The menu centers on the brand’s biang biang noodles and Wen Cheng noodle bowls with beef, tofu and shiitake, aubergine, and orange chicken toppings, plus Szechuan fried chicken bao, fried tofu bao, orange chicken bites, and chicken dumplings.
cuisines_en: ["northwestern Chinese wheat dishes", "biang biang noodles", "bao buns"]

intro_zh: Wen Cheng Joachimsthaler 分店菜单完整保留牛肉、孜然羊肉、豆腐香菇、茄子和橙汁鸡几种面条浇头。按文成规则，这些宽面都归入𰻝𰻝面体系，另有川味炸鸡刈包、炸豆腐刈包、猪肉韭菜饺子和橙汁鸡块。
intro_en: This Wen Cheng branch in Charlottenburg serves the brand’s biang biang and Wen Cheng noodle bowls with beef, lamb and cumin, tofu and shiitake, aubergine, and orange chicken toppings, plus Szechuan fried chicken bao, fried tofu bao, pork and chive dumplings, and orange chicken bites.
cuisines_en: ["northwestern Chinese wheat dishes", "biang biang noodles", "bao buns"]

intro_zh: Wen Cheng Simon-Dach-Straße 分店供应品牌核心的𰻝𰻝面和 Wen Cheng 招牌面，浇头包括牛肉、孜然羊肉、豆腐香菇、茄子和橙汁鸡。菜单还包括川味炸鸡刈包、炸豆腐刈包、猪肉韭菜饺子和橙汁鸡块。
intro_en: This Wen Cheng branch in Friedrichshain serves the brand’s core biang biang and Wen Cheng noodle bowls with beef, lamb and cumin, tofu and shiitake, aubergine, and orange chicken toppings, plus Szechuan fried chicken bao, fried tofu bao, pork and chive dumplings, and orange chicken bites.

intro_en: This Wen Cheng branch in Eberswalder Straße / Prenzlauer Berg serves the brand’s core biang biang and Wen Cheng noodle bowls, plus Szechuan fried chicken bao, fried tofu bao, dumplings, and orange chicken bites where available.

intro_zh: 文厨房是 Mariendorf 一带偏家常路线的中餐馆，菜单覆盖红油抄手、锅贴、小笼包等点心，也有水煮牛肉、水煮鱼片、辣子鸡、鱼香茄子和椒盐大虾这类更适合正餐分享的热菜。整体风格比快餐店更完整，适合想在南部居民区吃一顿中式热炒和点心的人。
intro_en: Wen's Küche is a home-style Chinese restaurant in Mariendorf with a mix of dim sum, wok dishes, Sichuan-leaning spicy plates, and Shanghai-style comfort dishes. Red oil wontons, guo tie, xiao long bao, water-boiled beef, fish fillet, yu xiang eggplant, and salt-and-pepper prawns make it a practical choice for a casual Chinese meal in the southern part of Berlin.

intro_zh: 威玲餐厅位于 Bundesplatz 附近，菜单以川味重口热菜、锅仔和烤鱼为主，并有贵州酸汤鱼、干锅牛肉、木姜鸡、辣炒鸡爪及傣味烤鱼等需提前预订的特色菜。适合想吃香辣、酸辣和多人分食大菜的客人。
intro_en: Willing near Bundesplatz serves Sichuan-leaning spicy mains, grilled fish and shareable pots, alongside advance-order Guizhou and Dai-style specials such as sour-soup fish, dry-pot beef, litsea chicken and grilled sea bass.
cuisines_zh: ["川菜", "贵州菜", "家常菜", "烤鱼", "锅物"]
cuisines_en: ["Sichuan cuisine", "Guizhou cuisine", "home-style Chinese dishes", "grilled fish", "hotpot dishes"]

intro_zh: Wok Show / 北方水饺是 Prenzlauer Berg 很明确的饺子馆，菜单重点是手工饺子，馅料从三鲜、鱿鱼海鲜到牛肉、羊肉、猪肉和素馅都有。除了饺子，也能点到口水鸡、猪耳朵、宫保鸡丁、麻婆豆腐和炸鸭等家常热菜，适合想专门吃一顿北方水饺的人。
intro_en: Wok Show is a clear dumpling-focused Chinese restaurant in Prenzlauer Berg. Handmade jiaozi are the core, with fillings such as sanxian, squid seafood, beef and celery, lamb and cabbage, pork and chive, vegetarian, and vegan options. A smaller set of Sichuan-style starters and wok dishes rounds out the menu.
cuisines_zh: ["北方菜", "饺子", "家常菜", "川味小菜"]

intro_zh: WUNDERBAR 恩典之家是 Wilmersdorf 一家菜单跨度很大的中餐馆，既有肉夹馍、馅饼、素饺子这类北方主食，也有梅菜扣肉、回锅肉、豆豉蒸排骨、北京烤鸭、孜然羊肉和水煮鱼等适合多人分食的菜。整体更像适合围桌点菜的正餐馆，而不是只做快餐的小店。
intro_en: WUNDERBAR is a Wilmersdorf Chinese restaurant with a broad menu that ranges from northern-style staples such as roujiamo, Chinese pies, and dumplings to shareable mains like steamed pork belly with preserved vegetables, hui guo rou, black-bean pork ribs, Peking duck, cumin lamb, and Sichuan boiled fish.
cuisines_en: ["northern Chinese dishes", "home-style Chinese dishes", "Sichuan dishes", "banquet-style dishes"]

intro_zh: 喜面 Mitte 店是一家产品线很聚焦的手工面馆，核心是𰻝𰻝面和兰州风格牛肉面。菜单不大，但牛肉、豆腐、鸡肉、鸭肉等宽面口味和几种兰州面构成了清晰主线，适合想专门吃一碗手工面的人。
intro_en: Xi Mian Mitte is a focused hand-pulled noodle shop built around biangbiang noodles and Lanzhou-style beef noodles. The menu is compact, with beef, tofu, chicken, and duck biangbiang options alongside Lanzhou noodle soups and a small dumpling option.

intro_zh: 喜面2店位于 Prenzlauer Berg，菜单以手工面为主，包括 Biang Biang 面、兰州汤面和多种担担面，也提供抄手、饺子、包子及几款凉菜。
intro_en: Xi Mian's Prenzlauer Berg branch centers on hand-pulled noodles, including biang-biang noodles, Lanzhou noodle soups and several dandan noodle variations, with wontons, jiaozi, baozi and cold starters alongside.
cuisines_zh: ["手拉面", "Biang Biang面", "兰州拉面", "川味面食", "包子"]
cuisines_en: ["hand-pulled noodles", "biang-biang noodles", "Lanzhou hand-pulled noodles", "Sichuan noodle dishes", "baozi"]

intro_zh: 新会城是 Moabit 一家偏粤式简餐和点心的小馆，菜单重点包括叉烧包、肠粉、豉汁排骨、豉汁凤爪、干炒牛河、烧鸭、烧肉和煲仔饭。它更适合想吃粤式点心、烧味饭和港式小吃的人，而不是重麻重辣川菜路线。
intro_en: Xin Hui City is a Cantonese-leaning Chinese spot in Moabit built around dim sum, roast meats, steamed pork ribs, chicken feet, rice rolls, claypot rice, and beef fried rice noodles. It is better suited to Cantonese snacks and rice plates than to heavy Sichuan-style dishes.

intro_zh: 宴火是 Westend 一家以火锅和烤肉为主的聚餐型中餐馆，菜单重点放在和牛、安格斯牛、羊肉、猪五花、鸡腿肉、虾、扇贝、三文鱼和鲜鱼片等涮烤食材上。它更适合朋友聚会或多人分食，而不是单人快餐。
intro_en: Yan Huo BBQ & Hot Pot is a Westend Chinese restaurant for group hot pot and BBQ meals. The menu centers on premium beef cuts, lamb, pork belly, chicken thigh, shrimp, scallops, salmon, fish fillets, hot pot broths, handmade noodles, and dumplings.

intro_zh: 杨国福 Mitte 店是标准的自选称重麻辣烫门店，重点不是固定菜谱，而是按个人口味选择锅底和配菜。它适合想吃一碗快速、热乎、可自定义麻辣烫的人。
intro_en: Yangguofu Mitte is a malatang branch built around customizable bowls and selectable broth bases rather than fixed dishes. It suits diners looking for a quick, hot, customizable Chinese malatang meal.

intro_zh: Yi23 宜味馆位于 Mitte，菜单以鸳鸯碗、担担面、油泼宽面、牛肉面、饺子和馄饨为主，也有湖南小炒肉、麻婆豆腐、鱼香茄子、东坡肉和多款包子。
intro_en: Yi23 China Taste in Mitte serves Yin-Yang combination bowls, dandan noodles, chili-oil wide noodles, beef noodle soup, dumplings and wontons, alongside Hunan pork, mapo tofu, yuxiang eggplant, Dongpo pork and baozi.

intro_zh: 一家是 Kreuzberg 一家菜单层次比较丰富的中式小馆，点心、手工面、饺子和盖饭都有。生煎包、小笼包、烧麦、虾饺和多种饺子是主线，也能点到夫妻肺片、口水鸡、炸鸭汤面和肥肠汤面。
intro_en: Yijia in Kreuzberg combines dim sum, handmade noodles, dumplings, Sichuan-style cold starters, noodle soups, and rice-plate mains. Shengjian bao, xiao long bao, siu mai, har gow, and several dumpling fillings form the core, with dishes like fuqi feipian, koushui chicken, roast duck noodle soup, and pork intestine noodle soup adding range.

intro_zh: 遇见易拉面馆是 Kreuzberg 一家以手工面为核心的小面馆，菜单里有油泼面、炸酱面、担担面、麻辣牛肉面、桂林米粉和广西老友粉，也有饺子、烧卖、虾饺和夫妻肺片等小吃。它适合想快速吃一碗热面或搭配几份小点的人。
intro_en: YiLa Nudel is a Kreuzberg noodle house centered on handmade noodles, with youpo mian, zhajiang mian, dan dan noodles, beef noodle soup, Guilin rice noodles, and old-friends rice noodles. Dumplings, siu mai, har gow, xiao long bao, and Sichuan-style small plates round out the menu.

intro_zh: 优米串烧是 Charlottenburg 的中式串烧/烧烤店，目前可见午餐菜单包括牛肉拌米线、烤五花、虾仁馄饨汤、猪肉白菜水饺汤、鸡排饭和皮蛋瘦肉粥。它更像白天能吃简餐、晚上偏串烧聚会的小馆。
intro_en: You Mi Chuan Shao is a Chinese skewer and BBQ spot in Charlottenburg. The visible lunch menu includes beef rice noodles, grilled pork belly, shrimp wonton soup, pork-and-cabbage dumpling soup, crispy chicken cutlet rice, and preserved egg pork congee.

intro_zh: You Mi 优米是 Schöneberg 一家综合型中餐馆，菜单从锅贴、小笼包、烧麦、虾饺到担担面、肥肠面、野山椒牛肉、剁椒鱼、红烧肉和麻辣香锅都有。它更适合想在 City West 吃点心、面食和川味热菜的人。
intro_en: You Mi in Schöneberg is a broad Chinese restaurant covering dim sum, noodles, Sichuan-style mains, fish dishes, dry pots, and rice-friendly hot dishes. Guo tie, xiao long bao, siu mai, har gow, dan dan noodles, pork intestine noodles, chopped-chili fish, braised pork belly, and mala xiang guo are representative options.
address: Nürnberger Str. 28 / Ecke Eislebener Str. 1, 10789 Berlin, Germany

intro_zh: Yumcha Heroes 是 Mitte 的创意点心店，菜单以各种饺子、包子、馄饨和小份分享菜为主，也有排骨、豆腐、鸭肉和海鲜类小菜。它更适合点几笼点心和小菜一起分享，而不是传统大盘热炒。
intro_en: Yumcha Heroes in Mitte is a creative dim sum restaurant built around dumplings, baozi, wontons, and small sharing plates, with ribs, tofu dishes, duck, seafood, and desserts rounding out the menu.

intro_zh: Yummy Dumpling 是 Prenzlauer Berg 的饺子和面食小店，主线是多种自制饺子、红油抄手、牛肉面、鸭肉汤面、馄饨面、卤肉饭和黑芝麻汤圆。它适合想吃饺子、汤面和简单中式主食的人。
intro_en: Yummy Dumpling in Prenzlauer Berg focuses on homemade dumplings, wontons in chili oil, beef noodle soup, duck noodle soup, wonton noodles, braised pork rice, and black sesame tang yuan.
cuisines_zh: ["饺子", "馄饨", "社区小店", "家常口味"]

intro_zh: 张拉拉牛肉面是 Prenzlauer Berg 的兰州拉面店，菜单核心是各种兰州牛肉面和拌面，配有牛肉夹馍、羊肉串、牛肉串、西北酱牛肉和香辣腐竹等小吃。这里适合专门吃一碗手拉牛肉面。
intro_en: Zhang Lala is a Prenzlauer Berg noodle house centered on Lanzhou-style hand-pulled beef noodles and mixed noodles, supported by roujiamo, lamb skewers, beef skewers, cold sliced beef, tofu sticks, and a few desserts.
cuisines_zh: ["兰州牛肉面", "手拉面", "西北面食", "Biang Biang 面"]
cuisines_en: ["Lanzhou hand-pulled noodles", "hand-pulled noodles", "northwestern Chinese wheat dishes", "biang-biang noodles"]

intro_zh: 张亮麻辣烫是 Friedrichstraße 的自选麻辣烫/小火锅门店，菜单以经典汤、冬阴功、菌菇汤、干拌麻辣烫和麻辣香锅等锅底或组合为主。
intro_en: Zhangliang Mini Hotpot is a Friedrichstraße malatang and mini-hotpot branch focused on broth bases, dry mala bowls, spicy wok dishes, and small hotpot sets.

intro_zh: Zhong Hua 是 Kreuzberg 一家老式中餐馆，菜单以汤、馄饨、宫保鸡丁、脆皮鸭、寿喜烧牛肉、咕噜肉和宫保虾等经典欧式中餐为主。
intro_en: Zhong Hua is a classic Kreuzberg Chinese restaurant with soups, wontons, gongbao chicken, crispy duck, sukiyaki beef, sweet-and-sour pork, and gongbao prawns.

intro_zh: Zhou’s Fine 是 Reinickendorf 的中餐正餐馆，菜单以北京鸭、牛肉、鸡肉、鸭肉、海鲜、猪肉和素菜等经典中餐热菜为主。
intro_en: Zhou's Fine is a Reinickendorf Chinese restaurant with Peking duck, beef, chicken, duck, seafood, pork, tofu, and vegetable dishes in a classic full-service format.

intro_zh: Zhou’s Five 是 Lichtenberg 的大型中餐馆/自助餐厅，菜单覆盖云吞汤、锅贴、鸡鸭牛肉、海鲜、素菜、麻婆豆腐和中式热菜。
intro_en: Zhou's Five is a large Lichtenberg Chinese restaurant and buffet-style venue with wonton soup, guo tie, chicken, duck, beef, seafood, vegetables, mapo tofu, and classic hot dishes.
